Why Join Pregis?

Pregis is in the packaging business to protect what matters. We are committed to providing our customers and employees sustainable growth through purpose-driven innovation and customer-centric packaging solutions. If you are looking for a company that is thriving across various high growth industries and is innovative, customer focused, high integrity, believes in strong teamwork and collaboration, Pregis is the company for you. Check out the Pregis Purpose to learn how sustainability and social responsibility is at the very core of our company DNA.

The Director of Strategic Accounts is responsible for developing and growing strategic national and integrator accounts while securing new business opportunities that drive profitable revenue growth. This role serves as the primary commercial lead for key customers, partnering with regional sales teams and internal stakeholders to develop long-term customer relationships, expand market share, and deliver comprehensive packaging and automation solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead strategic and integrator account activities, identifying opportunities to expand existing business and secure new national account partnerships.
  • Develop and execute account strategies that drive revenue growth, customer retention, and long-term partnerships.
  • Partner with Regional Sales Managers and cross-functional teams to develop, present, and implement customer solutions.
  • Prepare and deliver executive-level business reviews and sales presentations to accounts and distribution partners
  • Develop business proposals, contracts, and negotiations to establish long-term customers
  • Provide accurate forecasting and deliver regular reporting and business updates to leadership.
  • Monitor market trends, customer needs, and competitive activity to identify growth opportunities and support strategic planning.

Qualifications & Competencies

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, or a related field
  • Proven success translating specific customer needs into opportunities
  • Focus efforts towards revenue generation, customer retention and goal attainment
  • Experience within flexible packaging, protective packaging, or packaging automation is a plus
  • Experience selling through distribution channels

Travel

  • Ability to travel 40%-70% during peak seasons

Compensation The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions. Actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range based on factors including but not limited to performance, proficiency and demonstration of competencies required for the role. The base pay is just one component of Pregis’ total compensation package. The base pay range for this role is estimated to be $120,000-$145,000 plus bonus and company vehicle program.

Benefits & Rewards At Pregis, we invest in our employees' success both professionally and personally. In addition to a competitive compensation package, eligible employees may qualify for a sign-on incentive, relocation package, or gain-sharing programs. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance.

Eligible employees have access to:

  • Dental and Vision coverage
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Company-paid Life Insurance
  • 40% annual bonus incentive
  • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability coverage
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Continuous Development and Tuition Assistance
  • 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting
  • Paid Time Off, Holiday Pay, and Excellent Work-Life Balance
  • Company vehicle provided
  • Paid Parental Leave & Paid Military Leave
  • Pet Insurance and more!

Diversity and Inclusion

We believe in diversity of thought and bringing together other traits and characteristics that make an individual bring a unique experience to Pregis. We strive to foster an inclusive environment where behaviors and social norms ensure people are welcome.

Affirmative Action/EEO Statement/Inclusion

We offer equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type based on race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. raw.description:
Job Title: Accountant/ Finance Specialist

Location: India (Remote)

Employment Type: Part time

About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented and disciplined Accounts & Compliance Executive to manage bookkeeping, statutory filings, payroll compliance, and approved vendor payment execution for our India entity.

This role is execution-focused and requires strong accuracy, compliance knowledge, and integrity. It does not involve financial strategy or budgeting.

Key Responsibilities

📘 Bookkeeping & Accounting

    • Maintain complete books of accounts in Tally / Zoho Books / QuickBooks
    • Record sales, purchases, expenses, journal entries
    • Perform weekly bank reconciliation
    • Maintain vendor and customer ledgers
    • Track receivables and payables
    • Close monthly books by the 5th of each month
    • Prepare basic monthly P&L for internal review

🧾 GST Compliance

    • Prepare and file:
      • GSTR-1
      • GSTR-3B
    • Perform ITC reconciliation (2A / 2B)
    • Maintain GST working sheets
    • Track GST payable and ensure timely deposit

💼 TDS Compliance

    • Deduct TDS under applicable sections (194C, 194J, 192, etc.)
    • Deposit TDS before due date
    • File quarterly TDS returns (24Q, 26Q)
    • Download and issue Form 16 / 16A
    • Maintain TDS register

👥 Payroll, PF & ESI

    • Process monthly payroll deductions
    • File PF returns (EPFO portal)
    • File ESI returns (ESIC portal)
    • Generate challans and ensure timely payments
    • Maintain employee compliance records

💳 Vendor Payment Execution

    • Maintain vendor payment tracker
    • Verify invoice approvals
    • Create and send invoices to clients
    • Prepare payment summary sheet
    • Execute NEFT / RTGS payments via bank portal (as per approval)
    • Download and maintain UTR confirmations
    • No independent payment approval authority

Qualifications:

  • B.Com / M.Com required
  • 3–5 years experience in Indian accounting & statutory compliance
  • Strong working knowledge of:
    • GST portal
    • TRACES
    • EPFO
    • ESIC
  • Experience with Indian banking portals
  • Proficient in Excel (pivot tables, reconciliations)
  • High level of integrity and attention to detail

Bonus points if you have experience in process automation or digital finance tools.

Description

MWDN is an international recruitment and outstaffing company with 23+ years of experience connecting exceptional tech talent with leading companies across Israel, the USA, Great Britain, and Western Europe. In this role, MWDN acts as the recruitment partner, and the selected candidate will work directly with the client’s team on their product in an international environment

What is your new project?

  • Domain: Cybersecurity
  • Location: Israel
  • Company size: 11-50 employees
  • Founded in: 2020

What makes this project exciting?

The customer is one-stop-shop for Online Cyber Defense Solutions - an organization dedicated to Information Security and Cyber Defense in all ways and shapes. Their team of experts and specialists put the client’s defense ahead in order to solve the issue and ensure it won't repeat.

We are looking for a mid-level Product Designer who combines strong interaction and visual design skills with a practical approach to solving user problems.

You will take features from problem definition through to implementation, translating complex workflows into clear, intuitive interfaces. You should be comfortable working independently, explaining your design decisions, and collaborating closely with developers.

What makes you a great fit

  • 3–5 years of experience as a Product Designer, working on B2B SaaS products.
  • A portfolio of shipped work that demonstrates your design process, decision-making, and individual contribution. Experience limited to landing pages or marketing websites is not sufficient.
  • Strong interaction and visual design skills, particularly for complex, data-heavy interfaces.
  • Familiarity with mobile and responsive design, including adapting complex desktop workflows for smaller screens.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, including prototyping and reusable component creation.
  • Experience working with and contributing to design systems.
  • Ability to take ownership of features and work independently.
  • Clear communication skills and experience collaborating with developers.
  • Fluent English.

A portfolio is required to be considered for an interview. Please include a link with your application.

Your day-to-day in this position

  • Own the design of product features end to end, from understanding the problem to delivering designs and supporting implementation.
  • Create user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity screens, and interactive prototypes in Figma.
  • Design clear, efficient interfaces for complex sales workflows, including pipelines, tables, and dashboards.
  • Help shape the product’s mobile experience, beginning with responsive web and adapting complex interfaces for smaller screens.
  • Conduct lightweight user research and usability testing to validate ideas and improve designs.
  • Contribute to the design system by creating and refining reusable components and interaction patterns.
  • Collaborate with developers to communicate design intent, address implementation questions, and ensure the quality of shipped features.

Our next steps

✅ Intro call with a Recruiter — ✅ Client interview — ✅ Offer

raw.excerpt: About TuringTuring’s mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress.
raw.description:
About Turing

Turing’s mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. Headquartered in San Francisco, Turing works with frontier AI labs to generate high-quality datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and frontier research benchmarks that improve model capabilities in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and advanced STEM reasoning. In software engineering, Turing is the largest and longest-running data provider in the category. Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, retail, automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end-to-end agentic AI systems inside mission-critical workflows. By operating on both sides, Turing closes the loop between frontier research and enterprise deployment, turning real-world deployment signals into better data, evaluations, and more capable models. Learn more at .

About the role

Turing runs one of the world’s largest networks of vetted technical talent, onboarding contributors across more than 100 countries to work on frontier AI and enterprise engagements. Trust in that network starts with knowing, with confidence, that every person we engage is who they say they are, is eligible to work with us, and is not a sanctions or fraud risk. That is what this role protects.

As a Compliance Analyst, you own the quality and integrity of our Know Your Customer (KYC) and identity verification program. You will review and adjudicate verification cases, audit decisions made across our verification operation, detect emerging identity and document-fraud patterns, and turn what you find into sharper policy, cleaner process, and better-trained reviewers. You will make independent calls on ambiguous cases where the answer is not in the playbook, and you will raise the bar for everyone screening alongside you.

This is a hands-on, high-volume operations role for someone with deep KYC/AML judgment who is as comfortable making the hard decision on a single case as they are spotting the systemic pattern across thousands. You will work remotely, across time zones, with talent and stakeholders around the world.

What you’ll own

Case adjudication and identity verification

  • Review and decision KYC and identity verification cases across multiple regions, including document verification, liveness, and data cross-checks.
  • Make independent, well-reasoned decisions on ambiguous and high-risk cases where policy guidance is incomplete, escalating the right ones with a clear recommendation.
  • Detect and act on identity-fraud and document-fraud techniques — forgeries, manipulations, synthetic and stolen identities, and impersonation — adapting to how these differ across regions.

Sanctions, PEP, and AML screening

  • Conduct and resolve sanctions screening, politically exposed person (PEP) checks, and adverse-media review, clearing false positives and escalating true matches within our AML framework.
  • Apply AML and risk frameworks consistently, and document the rationale behind each disposition so decisions stand up to audit.

Quality assurance and calibration

  • Audit completed verification cases: sample decisions for accuracy, identify errors and policy deviations, and categorize root causes.
  • Run and contribute to calibration sessions, track accuracy scores and error trends, and give clear, constructive feedback to reviewers.
  • Turn QA findings into concrete improvements — policy updates, process fixes, and targeted training — and measure whether they worked.

Program and process improvement

  • Surface emerging fraud trends and control gaps to policy and operations leadership, with recommendations.
  • Help refine verification playbooks, decision trees, and documentation standards as regions, regulations, and fraud tactics evolve.
  • Write clear case documentation and reviewer guidance that others can act on without a translator.

What you bring

Required

  • 7+ years of experience in KYC, AML, identity verification, trust and safety, or fraud operations, ideally at a fintech, marketplace, gig/talent platform, or global staffing company.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of document verification and identity-fraud techniques across multiple regions.
  • Working knowledge of sanctions screening, PEP checks, and AML frameworks.
  • Experience in KYC quality assurance — auditing completed verification cases, sampling decisions for accuracy, identifying errors or policy deviations, and giving constructive feedback to reviewers.
  • Familiarity with QA frameworks and metrics such as accuracy scores, error categorization, calibration sessions, and root cause analysis, and the ability to turn QA findings into process or training improvements.
  • Experience with KYC/IDV platforms such as Onfido, Jumio, Persona, Sumsub, Veriff, or similar, and with screening tools such as World-Check, ComplyAdvantage, or LexisNexis.
  • Excellent judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to make independent decisions on ambiguous cases.
  • Strong written communication skills for case documentation and for talking with talent across cultures.
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-volume, remote environment.

Preferred

  • Relevant certification such as CAMS, CFE, or an equivalent AML/fraud credential.
  • Experience building or scaling a KYC/QA function, not just operating within one.
  • Exposure to global identity and data-privacy regimes (GDPR and similar) and to right-to-work or contractor-eligibility verification.
  • Comfort working with data — pulling your own samples, reading dashboards, and quantifying fraud and quality trends.

How we work

  • Remote-first and global. We operate across time zones and verify talent in more than 100 countries.
  • Judgment over scripts. The hard, ambiguous cases are the job; we trust you to make the call and show your reasoning.
  • Quality as a system. We measure accuracy, calibrate regularly, and fix root causes rather than symptoms.
  • Low ego, high ownership. The outcome — a trustworthy network — matters more than who caught what.

Values

  • We are client first: We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection.
  • We are AI forward: We help our clients build the future of AI and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing

  • Work at the frontier of AI, helping the world’s leading AI labs improve their most advanced models by building expert datasets, RL environments, and first-of-a-kind benchmarks.
  • Contribute to leading-edge AI research and showcase your work at top conferences such as ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS.
  • Bring frontier AI innovation to the enterprise, applying lessons learned from leading AI labs to solve real-world business challenges.
  • Collaborate with and learn from exceptional colleagues with deep AI experience from Google, Meta, Amazon, and other leading technology companies.
  • Move at the pace of AI innovation, with the speed, ownership, and impact of a startup.

Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

raw.description:
ROLE SUMMARY

Pfizer Commercial Oncology is introducing the world to the next era of cancer care. With a growing portfolio of novel therapies, industry-leading R&D, and a goal of delivering eight breakthroughs by 2030 across major cancer types, we're translating cutting-edge science into market-shaping impact. Here, you'll partner with exceptional colleagues across scientific, medical, and manufacturing teams, backed by advanced digital and AI-enabled infrastructure and the authority to accelerate medicines from discovery to delivery. Guided by our values of courage, excellence, equity, and joy, you'll have the opportunity to stretch your skills and build a career that evolves with you—across teams, roles, and the Pfizer enterprise. Join us to make history — for patients, for their families, for the future.


The Director/Team Lead, Oncology Field Access & Reimbursement – East Region is responsible for leading and coaching the Oncology Field Reimbursement Directors (FRDs) within the East region, with a key focus on executing a patient first approach to impact the patient access journey across the region. This individual will report directly to the Senior Director, National Oncology Field Access and Reimbursement Lead, and will be responsible for all Oncology products including oral oncolytics, IV and injectables, and copromotes. This individual will ensure regional alignment with the strategic vision of Pfizer Oncology's overarching access and reimbursement strategies and within the parameters of the organization's compliance expectations/guidelines. This role will also help lead the team’s transformation to a proactive, data-led engagement model to identify accounts’ educational needs.


ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Performance

  • Lead the regional execution of field Access & Reimbursement strategies and tactics and provide insights to Pfizer leadership across Oncology, Pfizer Patient Services, Chief Marketing Office, and other cross-functional partners
  • Review selected KPI metrics along with market and access trends to assess regional performance and provide necessary FRD coaching to adjust tactics, execution and/or strategy
  • Design and implement regional adoption of signal-based case prioritization, and support the region's transition towards measurement via compliant KPIs
  • Collaborate with FRDs and other leaders to appropriately manage budget and assign allocations and resources
  • Prioritize Oncology state societies and manage membership to ensure connectivity to reimbursement professionals
  • Manage FRDs' engagement in cross-functional account teams, at Medicare Administrative Carriers and with accounts

Leadership

  • Collaborate with the Oncology Field Access and Reimbursement Leadership team to develop strategy, align on change management approaches, and guide implementation. Share successes, best practices and experiences
  • Lead and set clear accountability with FRDs for execution of regional strategies and goals
  • Provide leadership, coaching, and development of FRD capabilities and the management of operational standards, evaluation of performance and ensuring compliance
  • Champion Pfizer’s Values and ensure behaviors are modeled by all colleagues within region

People and Culture

  • Optimize Regional Field Access & Reimbursement support through deployment, alignment, and vacancy management
  • Coach FRDs and provide colleague development, manage recruiting and hiring, talent and performance management
  • Lead and be accountable for the Region's PX-related processes to include, but not limited to: consistency in interviewing and hiring practices, Annual Goal Setting and Year-End Process (e.g. Team Performance and Year End Reviews), Annual Compensation Process (i.e. Merit, and LTI)
  • Lead and ensure a compliant culture within the region regarding all Pfizer policies, procedures and relevant regulations

Market/Customer/Cross-Functional Team

  • Understand the customer, access and reimbursement landscape, and provide insights and feedback to internal stakeholders to inform Access & Reimbursement strategy
  • Actively partner with cross- functional team, as needed and in compliance with Pfizer policies, to optimize appropriate patient support
  • Facilitate strong communication by gathering feedback from FRD colleagues to provide field perspective to leadership, VP and the cross-functional team on local access and reimbursement market information and trends
  • Participate in business planning by providing input and feedback gathered from FRD colleagues on local market insights and customer knowledge
  • Maintain technical expertise in access & reimbursement knowledge, customer market perspective, and market knowledge
  • Develop a thorough understanding of the drivers of local market dynamics

Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements)


  • Must have a Bachelor's degree with at least 8 years of pharmaceutical industry experience, preference for experience with market access, and/or coding and reimbursement.
  • General understanding of oncology reimbursement, including oncology payer dynamics, utilization management, government payment systems, patient services/access and reimbursement metrics, specialty pharmacy, co-pay assistance, buy and bill reimbursement, and academic vs. community provider nuance
  • Access and reimbursement experience across both oral and infused/injectable (buy & bill) products
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a highly regulated environment and adhere to strict company compliance guidelines and procedures
  • Ability to clearly define goals and associated outcomes metrics, and to lead a team in executing on goals and delivering on metrics
  • Matrixed leadership experience, with demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate cross-functionally
  • Proven track record of collaborating broadly with a diverse range of customers, clients, and stakeholders
  • Training in and experience in responsible business communication both written and spoken
  • Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.
  • Must be able to work during Eastern Time Zone hours and frequently travel within East region

Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements)


  • MBA, MHA, MPH, and/or additional certification in coding and reimbursement is preferred and 7+ years experience
  • Proven people leadership experience, including management of direct reports
  • Demonstrated experience in leading and motivating a team through change
  • Oncology market experience
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Exceptional relationship building skills, including outstanding collaboration and networking abilities
  • Ability to work in a team environment

Last Date to Apply: October 29, 2026

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $189,200.00 to $315,400.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 22.5% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. The Senior Microsoft Dynamics GP Consultant serves as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert for clients utilizing Microsoft Dynamics GP (Great Plains) across a variety of industries. This role is responsible for providing functional consulting, application support, troubleshooting, solution design, and business process optimization for Dynamics GP and related third-party applications.

Working directly with clients, the consultant will help resolve complex business and system challenges, recommend best practices, support upgrades and enhancements, and ensure clients maximize the value of their Dynamics GP investment. This is a highly client-facing role requiring strong consulting skills, deep Dynamics GP expertise, and the ability to build trusted relationships with stakeholders across finance, operations, sales, customer service, and leadership teams. In partnership with Deel’s recruitment platform, we are seeking a Senior Microsoft Dynamics GP Consultant based in LATAM for a remote Contractor of Record (COR) or Employer of Record (EOR) engagement. Candidates must be available to work during EST or CST business hours.

Position Responsibilities

Dynamics GP Consulting & Client Advisory

  • Serve as a functional expert for Microsoft Dynamics GP, providing guidance and recommendations to clients across multiple industries.
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into effective Dynamics GP solutions.
  • Lead solution design sessions, business process reviews, and system optimization initiatives.
  • Assist clients with system enhancements, upgrades, module implementations, and process improvements.
  • Recommend best practices that improve operational efficiency, reporting accuracy, and data integrity.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships by providing exceptional service and trusted advice.

Application Support & Issue Resolution

  • Provide advanced functional support for core Dynamics GP modules, including Financial Management, Distribution, Inventory, Purchasing, Sales Order Processing, Project Accounting, Fixed Assets, Payroll, and Field Service.
  • Troubleshoot complex application, transactional, and configuration issues.
  • Investigate and resolve data discrepancies, posting errors, reconciliation issues, workflow challenges, and integration-related concerns.
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end processes.
  • Coordinate with technical consultants and developers as needed to identify and resolve system issues.

Business Process Optimization

  • Evaluate existing client processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Configure Dynamics GP to support evolving business requirements.
  • Support workflow automation, approval processes, and operational efficiencies.
  • Help clients improve reporting capabilities, data quality, and system adoption.
  • Assist with documenting business processes and future-state recommendations.

Third-Party Applications & Integrations

  • Support and troubleshoot third-party applications commonly integrated with Dynamics GP, including SalesPad and other ISV solutions.
  • Assist with integration troubleshooting between Dynamics GP and external business systems.
  • Advise clients on configuration options, process impacts, and best practices when utilizing integrated applications.
  • Coordinate with software vendors and client stakeholders as needed to resolve issues and implement agreed enhancements.

Training, Documentation & Knowledge Sharing

  • Deliver user training and knowledge transfer sessions for clients.
  • Create and maintain functional documentation, process guides, and knowledge base articles.
  • Document solutions, root causes, and recommended corrective actions.
  • Provide functional guidance and knowledge sharing with other consultants as appropriate.
  • Identify recurrent issues and recommend long-term corrective measures.

Required Skills

  • Deep functional knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics GP.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a focus on root cause analysis and data integrity.
  • Ability to understand and improve business processes through technology solutions.
  • Excellent client relationship management and consulting skills.
  • Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and client engagements simultaneously.
  • Experience working within a managed services, consulting, or support environment.
  • Strong documentation and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Desired Skills

  • Bilingual in English and French.
  • Experience with SmartConnect and Dynamics GP integrations.
  • Familiarity with SQL Server and Dynamics GP reporting tools.
  • Previous experience in a Microsoft partner or consulting environment.

About Us

Endeavour Solutions is a top Microsoft Partner for ERP, CRM, and AI Cloud Business Applications, providing SMB, mid-market, and corporate clients with advisory services, implementation and training, and ongoing support for their Microsoft Business Applications. Key focus areas include Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Business Central, and Dynamics GP, supporting clients across the United States and Canada.

With offices coast-to-coast across Canada and the United States, Endeavour Solutions works with over 1,100 active clients spanning each of the major time zones across North America. Founded in 1989, Endeavour operates several key brands, including Endeavour Solutions, GP Support North, and Purely CRM.

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is $4,000–$4,200 USD per month, depending on years of comparable experience, skill set, and the unique value you bring.
  • Candidates must reside in a LATAM country and be legally authorized to work in their country of residence.

Transparency Statement

Accessibility & Inclusion

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

At Samsara, our People Partners contribute to organizational strategy and meaningfully impact business outcomes. We are looking for a People Partner to support key segments across our Go-To-Market (GTM) and Sales teams. Reporting directly to the Director, GTM People Partners, you will work alongside executive leadership, facilitate strategy, and solve high-impact, real-world business challenges.

We’re moving fast, reinventing playbooks, and actively embracing the new era of AI and modern organizational dynamics. We operate with a creative, problem-solving mindset that prioritizes common-sense solutions and business-focused metrics. If you thrive on building trusted leader relationships, tackling complex talent challenges, and driving measurable impact, this is the team for you.

This role is open to candidates residing in Canada.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Act as a Strategic Thought Partner: Establish yourself as an indispensable, embedded partner to sales and GTM leaders by aligning talent priorities directly with business outcomes.
  • Drive Creative Problem-Solving: Acts with urgency, proactively diagnosing team, manager, and organizational needs, and recommends business aligned solutions.
  • Execute Core Talent Programs: Drive continuous talent management, compensation/reward programs, and retention strategies designed to lower attrition in high-volume GTM environments.
  • Collaborate Across the People Function: Partner seamlessly with Regional People Partners, Program Managers, and COEs to build, scale, and seamlessly deliver strategic people solutions.
  • Champion Samsara's Culture: Role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.
  • Connect in Person: Travel roughly once per quarter for leadership offsites, business strategy meetings, and key team gatherings.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in People Operations.
  • Experience partnering with go-to-market teams (sales, CS or similar), or broader People experience (programs, talent, etc.)..
  • Learning oriented, with a record of picking up work you haven't done before and experience using AI tools to improve how you work.
  • Ability to work well in a fast-paced, iterative environment, open to changes in focus and direction.
  • Strong analytical capability, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to plan, scope and carry projects from design through delivery.
  • Experience using data to identify insights and inform business decisions.
  • Effective communication, consulting, coaching and facilitation skills.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$99,025—$128,150 CAD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

raw.description:
About us

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

About the role

In this role, you will be responsible for driving profitable business from an assigned group of brokers and partnering closely with our Sales organization. You will underwrite and manage products across Coalition’s portfolio, with a particular focus on enterprise-sized clients (~$1B+ revenue), while serving as a trusted partner to brokers and customers. You will help clients better understand how to protect their businesses, bringing together underwriting expertise, business acumen and a relationship-first approach.

This is a remote opportunity that can be based anywhere in the Central US with a strong preference for the Greater Chicago area.

Responsibilities

  • Underwrite and manage Coalition’s largest and most complex new and renewal accounts, while maintaining alignment to underwriting guidelines, risk appetite, and carrier requirements.
  • Shape overall portfolio strategy through management of the broker relationships responsible for placing Coalition’s largest and most complex accounts.
  • Maintain disciplined underwriting files, documentation, and internal tool usage in line with Coalition’s workflows and governance standards.
  • Lead highly complex negotiations on pricing, terms, structures, and exception requests in line with risk appetite, carrier requirements, and close partnership with CPU.
  • Serve as Coalition’s senior underwriting face for priority brokers, strategic clients, and flagship accounts, including executive-level discussions and regional market leadership.
  • Provide mentorship to other underwriters, helping raise the bar on underwriting discipline, broker communication, and deal strategy.
  • Represent Underwriting in cross-functional strategy discussions tied to portfolio optimization, product evolution, and market growth.
  • Partner with Coalition’s security team, Claims, Product, Actuarial, and CPU to address complex risk issues and translate technical, wording, and portfolio considerations into sound underwriting decisions.
  • Regular travel required for senior broker relationship management, client meetings, broker education, and market-facing leadership activity.

Skills and Qualifications

  • 8+ years of underwriting experience, including deep experience in cyber and Technology E&O and sustained success in complex production underwriting roles.
  • Demonstrated experience underwriting large/enterprise accounts (~$1B+ revenue) and managing a profitable book.
  • Expertise in analyzing complex cyber and Technology E&O risks and understanding their impact on underwriting, pricing, and portfolio outcomes.
  • Ability to combine deep underwriting expertise with broker and client needs to craft creative solutions and explain rationale credibly at senior levels.
  • Strong strategic thinking and ability to connect individual account decisions to broader portfolio, P&L, and market objectives.
  • Significant experience mentoring underwriters and influencing underwriting culture, standards, and operating practices.
  • Excellent executive presence, presentation skills, and comfort leading complex broker and client conversations in high-stakes settings.

Compensation

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The US base salary for this position ranges from $150,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $190,000/year in our highest geographic market. Consistent with applicable laws, an employee's pay within this range is based on a number of factors, which include but are not limited to relevant education, skills, job-related knowledge, qualifications, work experience, credentials, and/or geographic location. Your recruiter can share more on target salary for your location during the interview process. Coalition, Inc. reserves the right to modify this range as needed.

Perks

  • 100% medical, dental and vision coverage
  • Flexible PTO policy
  • Annual home office stipend and WeWork access
  • Mental & physical health wellness programs (One Medical, Headspace, Wellhub, and more)!
  • Competitive compensation and opportunity for advancement

Why Coalition?

Work at Coalition is centered on the joint mission to Protect the Unprotected. We have built a remote-first, highly inclusive culture that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds. We trust each other to take responsibility, share ownership of outcomes, and put in the work together to protect businesses from digital risk. Coalition’s exceptional growth stems from its ability to address real-world problems for organizations of all sizes while remaining true to our founding values of character, humility, responsibility, purpose, authenticity, and inclusion.

We’re always looking for collaborative, inquisitive individuals to join #OurCoalition.

Visit our Newsroom >

Privacy Notice

Coalition is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal information responsibly. We collect, use, and store personal information as necessary for the recruitment process and in compliance with applicable privacy laws and regulations in all regions where we operate. We want you to understand what personal information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding access, correction, and deletion of your data where applicable. Information submitted, collected, and processed as part of your application is subject to Coalition's Privacy Policy. For further details, please review our full Privacy Policy or contact us with any questions regarding how your information is handled.

Our Privacy Policy >

Safe Hiring Notice

All legitimate communication from Coalition comes from @coalitioninc.com emails, and open roles are listed only on our Careers page. We never ask for payment, banking details, or personal identification before an offer is accepted through our secure systems. If you believe you’ve been a victim of fraudulent recruiting, follow guidance from the Federal Trade Commission (FTC).

Anti-Discrimination Notice

Coalition is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Our policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all individuals, without discrimination or harassment on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable laws in each country where we operate. This commitment includes, but is not limited to, ensuring equal treatment in recruitment, selection, training, promotion, transfer, compensation, and all other aspects of employment. Coalition does not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, and we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace.

Accommodations

Coalition is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, including applicants and employees, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in each country where we operate. Our policy is to support equal opportunity in the hiring process by considering qualified applicants regardless of disability or other protected characteristics, unless providing accommodation would impose an undue hardship or disproportionate burden. If you require accommodation to complete an application, interview, pre-employment testing, or participate in the selection process, please contact us at . We also consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in line with applicable laws and regulations in each jurisdiction.

To all recruitment agencies: Coalition does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our email alias, employees, or other physical or virtual organization locations. Coalition is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

raw.title: Permit Reviewer - Flexible Hours
raw.excerpt: Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company.
raw.description:
Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

Scope of the Role:

We are recruiting US-based architects and certified plans examiners to evaluate the output of an AI system that performs automated building-code compliance review on architectural permit applications.

The system ingests permit submissions — new builds, alterations, modifications — and issues a compliant or non-compliant determination for each applicable check, drawn from the International Building Code. Every determination comes with a cited code provision and a marked location on the drawing set showing the evidence relied upon.

Your job is to tell us where the system got it wrong. You are applying the same judgment you already apply in plan review or permit preparation, to a set of determinations that have already been made. Where the system is correct, you confirm it. Where it is wrong, you correct it and the correction becomes training signal.

This is expert review work, not data entry. There is no volume of repetitive clicking to grind through and no generalist labeling pool to compete with — the entire premise of the program is that these judgments cannot be made by anyone without real code expertise.

What You’ll Own:

  • Review and correct pass/fail verdicts, written rationales, and citation boxes on PDF plans using the in-tool editing toolkit.
  • QA and correct labeling: Review AI-generated outputs, fix mislabeled data, and grade agent performance against what a real permit reviewer would conclude.
  • Interpret permitting checklists as an experienced reviewer would, applying the relevant requirements to the submitted plans.
  • Trace checklist requirements to their applicable source: IBC, IRC or other model codes, state building codes, or county/jurisdiction-specific amendments. Explain which requirement applies and why.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Have:

  • ICC certification relevant to building plan review, plus actual experience reviewing permit applications and issuing or resolving plan review comments.
  • Based in the United States, with at least 2 years of hands-on permitting experience; 5+ years strongly preferred.
  • Deep knowledge of how permitting actually works in the United States, with a preference for experience in Arizona, California, Florida, or Texas.
  • Plan examiner or Certified Building Official (CBO) experience and credentials. Provide certification details and the jurisdictions and project types you have reviewed.

The expected hourly range for this position is $50-$75 p/hour, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Please be aware of recruitment scams involving individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent employers. Innodata will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the application process. To learn more on how to recognize job scams, please visit the Federal Trade Commission’s guide at

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a recruitment scam, please report it to Innodata at and consider reporting it to the FTC at .

Mechanical Engineering Expert (MSc. or PhD)

Pay: $60–$120/hour

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

We are looking for a highly skilled Mechanical Engineering Expert to contribute to an AI training project involving engineering design, physical modeling, simulation, technical problem-solving, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks across structural, thermal, mechanical, and multiphysics domains. A representative task may require translating physical requirements into a computational model, generating the required geometry or mesh, applying materials and boundary conditions, running an engineering simulation, and determining whether the resulting artifact and analysis satisfy the applicable physical and design constraints.

This is a very coding heavy role. Candidates must have experience using coding agents in their workflow.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Solve and validate mechanical-engineering problems involving design, analysis, simulation, testing, or R&D.
  2. Translate physical systems and engineering requirements into analytical or computational models.
  3. Create or modify geometry, meshes, materials, loads, contacts, constraints, and solver inputs.

Required Qualifications

  1. An MS or PhD in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline; or
  2. Strong understanding of applied mechanics and mechanical-engineering fundamentals.
  3. Experience developing analytical, computational, or simulation-based engineering solutions.
  4. Practical proficiency with coding agents.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

Aerodynamics Expert (MSc. or PhD)

Pay: $80–$120/hour

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you can choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

We are looking for a highly skilled Aerodynamics Expert to contribute to an AI training project involving computational fluid dynamics, aerodynamic analysis, engineering simulation, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks that can be completed through programmatic, command-line-based workflows. A representative task may require analyzing an airfoil, preparing a computational domain and mesh, defining appropriate boundary conditions, running a CFD simulation, calculating lift and drag, and determining whether the resulting flow field is numerically and physically valid.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Solve and validate aerodynamic and fluid-dynamics problems.
  2. Translate physical requirements into computational models and solver-ready cases.
  3. Create or modify geometries, computational domains, and meshes.
  4. Define appropriate initial conditions, boundary conditions, fluid properties, and solver settings.
  5. Run CFD and aerodynamic-analysis workflows using command-line-accessible tools.
  6. Use Python to automate preprocessing, simulation execution, parameter sweeps, postprocessing, and validation.

Required Qualifications

  1. An MS or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering with an aerodynamics, fluid dynamics, or thermofluids specialization; or
  2. A BS in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering plus at least 1–2 years of aero-specific professional or research experience.
  3. Strong understanding of fluid mechanics and applied aerodynamics.
  4. Experience formulating and executing CFD or aerodynamic analyses.
  5. Practical proficiency with Python.
  6. Experience with at least one engineering tool or library that can be operated through a CLI, scripting interface, configuration files, or programmatic API.
  7. Ability to select and justify modeling assumptions, boundary conditions, mesh strategies, and solver settings.
  8. Ability to diagnose non-convergence, unstable solutions, incorrect results, and physically invalid outputs.
  9. Ability to communicate technical reasoning and engineering trade-offs clearly.

Relevant tools may include Python,OpenFOAM, SU2, Gmsh, FEniCSx, Elmer, CalculiX, SciPy, or similar programmatic engineering software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.

Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter, solver APIs, mesh-processing libraries, or domain-specific scientific packages. No single library is mandatory.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

Role Title: STEM Expert – Chemistry & Computational Chemistry (PhD)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (Worldwide)

Job Summary: In this role, you’ll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Design, evaluate, and critique chemistry and computational chemistry problems, workflows, and reasoning chains to support AI benchmarking initiatives.
  2. Provide expert-level insights on reaction mechanisms, synthesis planning, spectroscopy analysis, molecular simulations, and electronic structure methods.
  3. Assess and optimize experimental protocols, simulation parameters, and software configurations for accuracy and reproducibility.
  4. Analyze chemical, spectroscopic, and simulation data and provide actionable recommendations.
  5. Leverage domain knowledge to guide the development and validation of chemistry-related AI models and tools.
  6. Communicate complex scientific concepts clearly, both in writing and verbally, to technical and non-technical collaborators.
  7. Document findings, methodologies, and best practices to ensure knowledge transfer across the customer’s team.

Areas of Expertise (we welcome applicants from any of the following):

  1. Organic synthesis & reaction mechanisms
  2. Inorganic & organometallic chemistry
  3. Physical & theoretical chemistry
  4. Analytical chemistry & spectroscopy
  5. Computational chemistry & molecular dynamics
  6. Cheminformatics & drug discovery
  7. Materials science & polymer chemistry

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  1. PhD in chemistry, computational chemistry, chemical biology, materials science, or a closely related field.
  2. Hands-on research lab experience, including wet lab experience for experimental subfields, or extensive simulation-heavy research for computational subfields.
  3. Deep expertise in at least one of the areas listed above.
  4. Professional written and spoken English (C1 or higher).
  5. Proficiency in Python and/or industry-standard tools in your subfield (e.g., Gaussian, ORCA, Psi4, GROMACS, LAMMPS, RDKit).
  6. Excellent quantitative, analytical, and scientific reasoning skills.
  7. Outstanding written and verbal communication abilities, with the ability to clearly document and explain technical concepts.
  8. Track record of rigorous scientific problem-solving in complex chemistry domains.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Academic experience (postdoc, research scientist, faculty, or equivalent), strongly preferred.
  2. Peer-reviewed publications, patents, or contributions to open-source scientific software.
  3. Experience with AI/ML-assisted chemistry workflows or benchmarking.
  4. Background in drug discovery, reaction prediction, or retrosynthesis.

  3. Practical programming ability sufficient to implement and verify your own solutions.

Relevant competition platforms include Kaggle, DrivenData, Zindi, AIcrowd, Numerai, DataSource.ai, and CodaLab/Codabench.

Huge Pluses

  1. Strong coding experience, particularly in Python, including testing, debugging, and working with unfamiliar code

raw.excerpt: The Cruise Globe is the world's fastest-growing cruise app - the only place to accurately discover, track and relive every cruise voyage in the world.
raw.description:
The Cruise Globe is the world's fastest-growing cruise app - the only place to accurately discover, track and relive every cruise voyage in the world. Since launching in early 2025 it has become the digital home for 145,000+ cruisers, co-founded with Emma Cruises, one of the world's most influential cruise content creators, and her audience of over half a million people across YouTube and social.

The Cruise Globe Agency is the booking arm of that ecosystem. We intend for The Cruise Globe to become the world's leading cruise agency within a decade. We believe we have the data, the audience, the network and the team to do it - and this role is part of building that.

This is a content and data led agency, where real, trusted, expert human advisors convert genuine, high-intent demand from our community.

In the press: Travel Weekly - “The Cruise Globe hopes new agency will be world leader within a decade”

About the Role

This is a customer-facing Cruise Advisor role. You will handle high-intent enquiries from the Globe platform and Emma Cruises' audience, end to end - from first conversation through to a confirmed, well-serviced booking.

Customers will come back to you, refer their friends to you, and ask for you by name. That is the point of the role: we are building a team of named, visible, expert advisors for our community, not an anonymous call centre.

You will report to the Head of UK Agency, and you will also be supported by a sales support team who filter enquiries and handle pre-cruise admin, so your time goes where it matters - advising and closing.

The agency is growing rapidly and there is a genuine path to progress to Senior Cruise Advisor and, in time, Sales Manager.

What You Will Do

1. Advise and close, end to end

  • Take high-intent inbound enquiries by phone and email from the Globe platform and Emma Cruises' audience.
  • Build genuine rapport quickly - we want you to build long-standing relationships with your customers.
  • Design itineraries and quotes, and close cruise bookings across mainstream, premium and select luxury lines.
  • Book the whole trip where it adds value - flights, hotels, transfers and extras - not just the cruise.
  • Handle group bookings (big birthdays, anniversaries, reunions) confidently and accurately.

2. Be the guest’s trusted point of contact

  • Be the primary point of contact for your guests throughout the journey - the person they come back to, refer their friends to, and ask for by name.
  • Keep the CRM accurate and up to date - clean records, logged conversations and preferences are how guests are looked after properly and handed between advisors without anything being dropped.
  • Run a proactive post-booking service - pre-cruise touchpoints, price monitoring, and being genuinely useful before, during and after the trip.
  • Drive repeat bookings and referrals; treat the lifetime of the guest relationship, not the single transaction, as the goal.

3. Protect the brand

  • Give honest, unbiased advice. Our credibility is built on Emma's content and a community of over half a million cruisers - we never put commission ahead of the right recommendation.
  • Handle problems and crisis situations calmly, with the customer's interest first.
  • Operate to a high standard of accuracy on fares, cabins, payment schedules and documentation.

4. Work as part of a remote team

  • Excel in a fully remote, fast-paced environment - you should be self-directed, disciplined, and reliable without anyone looking over your shoulder.
  • Follow the agency's processes and QA standards - and feed back honestly when something can be done better.
  • Use the Globe platform's data on each customer (their wishlists, viewed itineraries and history) to know them before the first call.

The Bar

We are hiring the best cruise advisors in the country, and we are unapologetic about that. This is a high-pace, high-expectation environment. In return, you get something rare: high-quality, unconstrained inbound leads, a genuine community behind every conversation, and a fast-growing agency to grow with.

The annual personal quota for this role is £2.5 million in cruise GMV, and we can realistically give you every support needed to surpass this. This quota is significant by design. If that number excites you rather than daunts you, read on. If it daunts you, this is not the role for you.

Requirements

You must have:

  • A deep cruise specialism. You should be a genuine cruise specialist, not a generalist travel agent. Typically 3+ years directly within cruise, with strong knowledge of mainstream and premium lines, cabin nuance, fare and promotion mechanics, payment schedules and common booking pitfalls.
  • A demonstrable track record. You have a proven history of personal cruise sales success, with 7-figure annual booking volumes. You can talk credibly and specifically about what you have personally sold, your close rates, your repeat business and your referrals.
  • The ability to generate phone-first rapport. You build trust and warmth over the phone naturally. We believe in UK customers buying from a UK advisor.
  • CRM-fluency. You are confident and consistent with a CRM as a daily working tool - logging conversations, managing your pipeline, and keeping customer records clean. Good CRM discipline is a genuine differentiator for us, not an afterthought.
  • The ability to excel remotely. This is a fully remote role. You must be genuinely able to excel in that environment - self-motivated, organised, and consistent without supervision, comfortable working async over Slack, CRM and docs.
  • Ambition & Flexibility. We want to work exclusively with people who have a passion for this work, and aren’t afraid to put in the work required to achieve great things. That doesn’t always look like a standard 9 to 5.

It’s a bonus if you have:

  • Experience within a host agency or consortium model.
  • Familiarity with using T-Profile as a CRM.
  • Familiarity with Dolphin software (or comparable UK booking/back-office systems).
  • Working knowledge of UK regulatory context - ATOL and ABTA protection, and what it means for the customer.
  • Group cruise experience.
  • Personal cruise experience - we think that the more you cruise yourself the better placed you are to advise others.
  • A public track record of recognition - top producer, awards, supplier recognition.

Benefits

We will expect a lot of you, but by extension we will offer market-leading compensation and opportunities for real, fast progression.

  • Competitive base salary, calibrated to experience and track record, discussed at interview.
  • Tiered personal commission on the commission you generate, designed so a strong advisor earns substantially above base. Because demand is inbound and high-intent, the model is weighted towards genuine upside.
  • 25 days holiday plus UK bank holidays
  • Pension (statutory minimum)
  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in the UK, with the option to join us in our London office
  • Full access to industry familiarisation trips and ship inspection events
  • Laptop, phone system, and all tooling to operate at your best.
  • Staff Travel Discounts

Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

Scope of the Role:

The Business Development Representative will play a critical role in expanding Innodata’s Healthcare and Life Sciences business by identifying organizations investing in AI, reaching the right decision makers, and converting those conversations

The Business Development Representative, Healthcare & Life Sciences will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying new business opportunities across the healthcare and life sciences ecosystem. This role will focus on building pipeline with health systems, pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, medical technology organizations, payers, digital health companies, and other organizations investing in AI and data transformation.

The BDR will work closely with Innodata’s AI leadership to identify high-potential accounts, engage relevant technical and business decision makers, qualify opportunities, and transition qualified prospects into pilots and commercial engagements.

This role requires strong prospecting and communication skills combined with the ability to develop a working understanding of healthcare AI use cases, clinical and life sciences data, model development, and emerging agentic AI applications.

This role is approximately 70% outbound prospecting, account development, client-facing activity, and 30% account research & planning.

What You’ll Own:

Prospecting & Business Development

  • Identify and source prospective customers across healthcare and life sciences, including health systems, pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology companies, medical technology organizations, payers, and digital health companies.
  • Research target accounts to identify AI initiatives, strategic priorities, organizational changes, funding, product launches, and other potential business triggers.
  • Identify and engage relevant decision makers across AI, data science, machine learning, clinical operations, R&D, medical affairs, technology, product, and digital transformation organizations.
  • Develop highly targeted outbound campaigns using email, LinkedIn, industry events, conferences, and other prospecting channels.
  • Conduct discovery calls to understand customer requirements, timelines, technical challenges, and potential commercial opportunities.
  • Support the transition of qualified opportunities into pilots, proof-of-concept programs, and larger commercial engagements.
  • Coordinate prospect meetings, follow-ups, presentations, demonstrations, and technical discussions with Innodata subject matter experts.

The BDR should have sufficient domain fluency to connect these capabilities to healthcare and life sciences use cases such as clinical AI assistants, medical documentation, patient engagement, medical imaging, clinical trials, drug development, pharmacovigilance, medical affairs, regulatory workflows, and enterprise AI applications.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 2–5 years of experience in business development, technology sales, healthcare technology, life sciences, AI, data services, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated success generating pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting.
  • A consultative approach to business development focused on understanding customer problems rather than simply pitching products.
  • Understanding of healthcare and life sciences workflows such as clinical operations, medical imaging, clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, medical affairs, drug development, patient engagement, or enterprise healthcare operations.
  • Familiarity with healthcare and life sciences data, including clinical records, medical imaging, scientific literature, real-world data, or other multimodal medical datasets.

The expected salary range for this position is $70,000 – $85,000 USD per year, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

259,000 zł - 379,000 zł

raw.description:
About The Opportunity

Netrix Global is looking for aSecurity Analyst  for the Managed Services – Security department.

We are looking for a people with experience in Security Analisys to join our technology team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for monitoring, triaging, and investigating security events across client environments. This role supports timely incident identification, clear client communication, and effective escalation of confirmed or high-risk threats. The Threat Analyst applies technical analysis, threat intelligence,
and documented response procedures to help protect client information assets.rds.

How You Will Make An Impact 

    Monitor and analyze security events across network, endpoint, and cloud environments using Elastic SIEM to identify suspicious activity, threats, and policy violations.

  • Investigate and validate potential security incidents, including malware infections, phishing campaigns, unauthorized access attempts, and other malicious activities.
  • Perform initial triage, classification, and prioritization of security alerts to determine impact, severity, and required response actions.
  • Support incident response efforts by collecting and analyzing relevant evidence, escalating critical threats, and assisting with containment and remediation activities.
  • Correlate logs and security events from multiple data sources, including firewalls, IDS/IPS, web servers, endpoints, and cloud platforms, to identify indicators of compromise.
  • Develop, tune, and optimize detection rules, dashboards, and alerts within Elastic SIEM to improve visibility, detection accuracy, and operational efficiency.
  • Leverage threat intelligence, including Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) and adversary TTPs, to enhance detection capabilities and strengthen security monitoring.
  • Document investigations, incident findings, response actions, and lessons learned to support continuous improvement of security operations and response processes.
  • Produce security metrics, reports, and operational summaries that communicate threat trends, incident activity, and program effectiveness to stakeholders.
  • Collaborate closely with Security Operations, IT, and other cross-functional teams to ensure a coordinated and effective approach to threat detection and incident response.
  • Contribute to process improvements, operational procedures, and knowledge-sharing initiatives that strengthen the organization's overall security posture.
  • Stay current on emerging threats, attack techniques, vulnerabilities, and security best practices to continuously improve monitoring and detection capabilities.

What You Will Bring To The Table

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and technical documentation skills.
  • Ability to investigate security events, analyze findings, and communicate risks and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience monitoring, investigating, and responding to security incidents within a SOC or security operations environment.
  • 2+ years of experience in cybersecurity, security operations, threat detection, incident response, or a related technical role preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with Elastic SIEM or comparable SIEM platforms for monitoring, investigations, alerting, and log analysis.
  • Strong understanding of security operations concepts, including incident triage, threat detection, alert management, and escalation procedures.
  • Knowledge of network security fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, SMTP, firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs, and common attack vectors.
  • Experience performing log analysis and event correlation across endpoints, networks, cloud platforms, and security technologies.
  • Familiarity with threat intelligence concepts, Indicators of Compromise (IOCs), MITRE ATT&CK, and common adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures.
  • Understanding of Windows, Linux, and cloud environments, including common authentication mechanisms and security logging sources.
  • Experience working with ticketing systems, case management platforms, and security documentation processes.
  • Advanced English.

Location

  • Buenos Aires, Argentina (Any part of the country it is great for us)

Shift

  • Sunday to Thursday or Tuesday to Saturday day shift.

What We Offer

  • Swiss Medical SMG 30 (primary family group)
  • AWS certifications.
  • Corporate benefit program with Pedidos Ya!
  • Discounts at Unilever, Samsung, BGH, Peña Flor, among others
  • Discounts in educational institutions
  • Internet and connectivity
  • Compensation for childcare expenses (from 0 to 3 years old)
  • Competitive salary and benefits
  • English in company
  • Work from Anywhere: You can work from all over the world
  • Gifts for special dates (marriage, graduation, birthdays, etc.)
  • Christmas Box
  • Day off for birthdays
  • 10 (ten) calendar days of paternity leave
  • An awesome learning environment for you to develop

About Us   

At Netrix Global our values are the philosophies and principles that live by. They support our vision, help us achieve our goals and commit us to a common purpose.

We Own Outcomes, Win Together, Make An Impact, Enjoy The Journey, and Respect All!     

Netrix Global is a mission-driven organization with the goal of providing the people, processes, and technology needed to run and scale modern, data-driven businesses that are always on and always secure. Our breadth of capabilities allows us to provide holistic offerings that solve even today’s most complex business challenges, delivering to you an integrated, optimized, and future-proof solution.    

We work with clients of all sizes and specialize in solutions for healthcare, manufacturing, government, education, financial services, and legal industries. Netrix is consistently ranked in the CRN VAR500, detailing the country’s top system integrators.   

At Netrix, we’re driven to solve business problems with innovative technology solutions. We focus on end-users and are committed to client satisfaction.   

What You Can Expect From Us

We offer a competitive compensation package, comprehensive group benefits to meet the needs of you and your family, flexibility, and time off when you need it, and a casual work environment. The role can be remote/home office, with some travel required.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.
