Job Title: Business Analyst (Agile)

Location: Caribbean/Remote

Role Summary

The Agile Business Analyst will be a key partner to the internet and mobile banking teams, driving the successful delivery of agile projects that enhance digital banking experiences. This role bridges business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring solutions are customer- centric, compliant, and aligned with business objectives. The Agile BA will champion agile practices, facilitate rapid iteration, and support continuous improvement in a dynamic financial services environment. They will develop a deep understanding of the product and provide the business context with a focus on the end-to-end process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Agile Requirements Elicitation & Analysis: Collaborate with product owners, stakeholders, and development teams to gather, refine, and prioritize user stories and requirements. Facilitate workshops, interviews, and agile ceremonies (e.g., sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives). Translate business needs into clear, actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.
  • Business Process Improvement: Analyze current digital banking processes, identify pain points, and recommend enhancements leveraging agile methodologies. Support automation, digitization, and regulatory compliance in solution design. Identify potential impacts of proposed designs to any element of the end-to-end process.
  • Solution Design & Validation: Work with cross-functional teams to design and validate solutions that meet business and customer needs. Participate in solution evaluation, ensuring alignment with agile principles and maximizing value delivery.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Communication: Develop stakeholder maps and communication plans tailored to agile project environments. Act as a liaison between business and technical teams, ensuring transparency and shared understanding.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Support the creation and execution of test plans, including user acceptance testing (UAT) and continuous feedback loops. Troubleshoot issues and facilitate rapid resolution during sprints.
  • Documentation & Training: Maintain agile documentation (user stories, process maps, release notes). Facilitate training and onboarding for new systems and processes. Identify new procedures and job aids to be developed or impacts to existing documentation.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting: Provide insights through data analysis to inform decision- making and measure project success.
  • Continuous Improvement: Foster a culture of continuous improvement, leveraging agile metrics (velocity, burndown charts) and feedback

Critical Skills & Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 3+ years experience as a Business Analyst on agile projects, preferably in financial services or digital banking.
  • Proven track record supporting internet/mobile banking initiatives.

Technical Skills

  • Deep understanding of agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe).
  • Proficiency in agile tools (Jira, Confluence, Trello).
  • Experience with process mapping (BPMN), user story writing, and backlog management.
  • Clear understanding of technical concepts, including familiarity with APIs, mobile/web technologies, and SDLC.
  • Data analysis and visualization skills using tools such as Excel, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Strong knowledge of business analysis methodologies (e.g., BABOK).
  • Proficiency in producing quality requirements and process deliverables (e.g., BRDs, use cases, user stories, process maps) and other related documentation.
  • Proficiency in process mapping and modeling tools (e.g., Visio) and techniques.

Key Competencies

  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving in fast-paced, agile environments.
  • Ability to apply structured, logical, and data-driven approaches to understand complex business problems and deliver actionable insights.
  • Consistently demonstrates the ability to work autonomously, proactively seeking out information and resources to understand tasks and deliver results
  • Takes ownership of responsibilities, makes informed decisions, and manages assignments with minimal supervision or reliance on others for context or direction.
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities.
  • Adaptability and resilience in dynamic project settings.
  • Commitment to industry best practices (IIBA BABOK, Agile Manifesto).

Certifications (Preferred)

  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Certified Product Owner (CSPO), IIBA Agile Analysis Certification (IIBA-AAC), or equivalent.
  • Certification of Capability in Business Analysis (CCBA) or PMI-PBA certification.

About Beazley Security

Beazley Security is a global cybersecurity firm committed to helping clients enable advanced cyber defenses that reduce risk with quantifiable results. We’re comprised of top talent from private industry, government, intelligence, and law enforcement who are specialists in threat detection, incident response, digital forensics, offensive security, risk management, and cyber resilience. As a subsidiary of a specialty insurance giant, Beazley Insurance, we’ve been at the forefront of cyber insurance management and breach response activities for business clients in the US, UK, and Europe since 2017. As Beazley Security, the company will have an expanded scope, leveraging nearly two decades of cyber incident experience, a strong services division, and a business strategy focused on growth, to realize our goals and deliver benefits to clients.

As a company, we are committed to upholding our core values of Belonging, Integrity, Service, Accountability, and Curiosity. We believe these values are essential to creating a strong and inclusive workplace culture, as well as to deliver world-class cybersecurity solutions to our clients worldwide. As Beazley Security, these values will continue to thrive, with an extra emphasis on expansion of our capabilities and capacity in helping solve unique client challenges.

Summary

The Director of Crisis Simulations owns, manages and delivers Beazley Security's worldwide portfolio of tabletop exercises and crisis simulations (“tabletops”), ensuring consistent quality, strong client outcomes and global delivery across regions and time-zones.

Operating as the leader of an entrepreneurial practice within Beazley Security, the role is accountable for delivery standards, the paid-tabletop revenue line, team development and growth aligned to sales.

The role reports to the Head of Cyber Services and manages consultants dedicated to delivering tabletops but is also expected to deliver flagship, board-level and complex multi-party tabletops personally.

Responsibilities

Practice ownership and delivery

  • Own global tabletop delivery end-to-end, including intake, scheduling, scenario design, facilitation, after-action reporting and follow-up.
  • Ensure every tabletop is delivered against client entitlement, agreed service levels and regional requirements.
  • Personally facilitate flagship, board-level and complex multi-party tabletops.
  • Establish and maintain a single global methodology, scenario library, templates and quality standards.

Commercial growth and financial management

  • Develop executive, technical, multi-team and sector-specific offerings and pricing with Cyber Services leadership.
  • Convert retainer tabletop clients into paid follow-on engagements in partnership with brokers, underwriters and account teams.
  • Manage the growth budget, investing within agreed guardrails in hiring, coaching, marketing, events and media.

Team leadership and talent

  • Lead, coach and develop the crisis simulation team, initially comprising [xxx] direct reports across the Americas and International regions.
  • Grow the team in line with paid tabletop revenue and the agreed growth rule(s).
  • Build a development pathway from Incident Management to “RMO” tabletops and then paid tabletops.
  • Enable two-way capacity support between Incident Management and the crisis simulation team during delivery peaks and incident surges.
  • Expand language and regional coverage, beginning with English, French and Spanish and adding capability as demand develops.

Market presence

  • Raise the profile of the practice and its people through conferences, industry events, media appearances and published thought leadership.
  • Lead agile practice-level marketing in coordination with the Client Experience and Marketing teams.

Group and Zurich integration

  • Position the practice as the cyber crisis-simulation capability for the wider Zurich group, including Zurich Resilience Services clients.
  • Prepare the practice to deliver exercises funded by any future Zurich retainer and to integrate crisis-resilience specialists who may join from Zurich Resilience Services.

Performance and success measures

  • Track delivery against entitlement and schedule, client satisfaction, paid revenue, conversion, team growth, retention, utilisation and return on Growth Budget investment.
  • Measure market reach through speaking opportunities, media appearances, events and expansion of language and regional coverage.

Qualifications

  • Substantial hands-on experience in cyber incident response and crisis management, ideally within a digital forensics and incident response or insurer-backed incident response environment.
  • Proven record of designing and facilitating tabletop exercises for technical teams, executive committees and boards.
  • Experience leading and developing a client-facing team across multiple regions.
  • Commercial experience building, pricing and selling an offering and managing a revenue line.
  • Experience working with insurers, brokers and the cyber insurance ecosystem.

Skills and attributes

  • Executive presence and outstanding facilitation skills, with confidence presenting to boards, media and conference audiences.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset combined with financial discipline and a focus on investment that drives measurable growth.
  • Strong methodology and quality focus, with the ability to turn specialist expertise into repeatable products.
  • Ability & willingness to work with colleagues and direct reports across global time zones, from UTC -7 to UTC +10.
  • Willingness to travel international

Beazley Security Offers

  • Competitive salary and bonus.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Generous leave policies including 3 months paid parental.
  • 100% of employee-only insurance premiums covered (healthcare, dental and vision).
  • Up to 5% matched 401k contribution.
  • Opportunities for career advancement and ongoing training.
  • Participation in industry conferences and events.

raw.description:
About Us:

Thrive is a rapidly growing technology solutions provider focusing upon Cloud, Cyber Security, Networking, Disaster Recovery and Managed Services. Our corporate culture, engineering talent, customer-centric approach, and focus upon “next generation” services help us stand out amongst our peers. Thrive is on the look-out for individuals who don’t view their weekdays spent at “a job”, but rather look to develop valuable skills that ignite their passion and lead to a CAREER. If you’re attracted to a “work hard, play hard” environment, seeking the guidance, training and experience necessary to build a lucrative career, then welcome to THRIVE!!

Position Overview:

This position offers you the opportunity to join our rapidly growing organization. We're looking for people with initiative, autonomy, and leadership ability to optimize both process and delivery around our Security offerings.

In this role, the ideal candidate will be responsible for supervising our Security Operations Center in providing excellent customer service and resolving all technical issues. As Director, you should have a solid technical security background combined with customer service expertise. A problem-solving attitude with an ability to motivate your team to achieve specific goals are essential skills to perform well in this position. Ultimately, you should be able to ensure high quality technical support and increase client satisfaction.

Primary Responsibilities:

· Oversee the daily operations of Thrive’s Security Operations Center which includes leading and mentoring team of Tier 1 and Tier 2 SOC Analysts

· Primarily responsible for security event monitoring, incident response, and resource management

· Develop and implement processes and procedures for incident response, threat detection and analysis, security event management, and reporting.

· Develop playbooks for incident response and incident management processes, including threat triage, incident investigation, and incident resolution.

· Ensure compliance to Service Level Agreement, process adherence and process improvement to achieve operational objectives.

· Perform threat management, threat modeling, identify threat vectors and develop use cases for security monitoring.

· Proactive monitoring and response to known and/or emerging threats.

· Creation of reports, dashboards, and metrics for clients and Sr. Mgmt.

· Motivate and coach individual contributors to achieve departmental goals and drive excellent and consistent customer service.

· Drive continuous improvement of SOC incident handling and security investigations.

· Define metrics and KPIs to drive quality and efficiency.

· Conduct annual performance reviews for all direct reports.

· Uphold procedural requirements around prioritization, communication, documentation, escalations, etc.

· Follow up with customers to identify areas of improvement and provide customer feedback to the appropriate internal teams and management.

· Escalation point for SOC customer service and technical issues.

· Ability to adjust priorities and balance responsibilities in a fast-paced environment.

· Other duties as required.

Requirements

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology or related discipline preferred, or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
  • Professional experience in a system administration role supporting multiple platforms and applications.
  • Proven critical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with creating playbooks and effective security processes.
  • · Excellent Written and Verbal Communication Skills
  • 2-3 years of SOC experience; managerial experience preferred.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • CISSP preferred

raw.title: ML/Data Engineer

raw.description:
Intetics Inc., a global technology company providing custom software application development, distributed professional teams, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced ML/Data Engineer to join our dynamic team on a full-time basis.

Customer location: USA

Candidate locations: EU ONLY

Working hours: 11.00-20.00 CET

Language: English B2+

Estimated start date: 16.11.2026

Duration: 12 months

Project Responsibilities

  • Design and build production data infrastructure for high-volume athlete performance and sensor data.
  • Build and operate real-time and near-real-time ingestion systems for streaming data.
  • Design storage and data architectures for high-volume time-series data and longitudinal athlete records.
  • Build infrastructure that makes production features and derived metrics available to machine learning systems and AI agents with low latency.
  • Design and implement graph data models and schemas representing relationships between athletes, training loads, injuries, performance, and outcomes.
  • Build data and ML evaluation infrastructure that helps measure model reliability, calibration, and performance across real-world cases.
  • Design systems that maintain strong tenant-level data isolation across clubs and customers.
  • Establish appropriate data provenance, lineage, auditability, and observability across the platform.
  • Work with ML and AI engineers to provide reliable data foundations for model training, inference, and evaluation.
  • Work with sport scientists and domain experts to translate complex requirements into durable production systems.
  • Make pragmatic technology and architecture decisions as the platform evolves.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of full-time professional software or data engineering experience, excluding internships, university placements, coursework, and academic projects.
  • Proven experience designing, building, and operating production data infrastructure at scale.
  • Strong experience working with time-series data or time-series databases, such as InfluxDB, TimescaleDB, Prometheus, ClickHouse, or equivalent technologies.
  • Significant experience with real-time or streaming data ingestion, using technologies such as Kafka, Kinesis, Flink, Spark Streaming, Pulsar, or equivalent.
  • Experience designing graph data models or graph database schemas, not simply querying or consuming an existing graph database.
  • Experience designing or operating multi-tenant systems with tenant-level data isolation.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills. Professional experience with Go is highly desirable.
  • Experience working with production systems where reliability, scalability, observability, and data correctness matter.
  • Ability to take ownership of ambiguous technical problems and turn them into practical production architectures.
  • Experience working directly with data scientists, ML engineers, or other technical domain specialists.
  • Experience building probabilistic evaluation, model calibration, or model monitoring infrastructure.
  • Experience with causal inference, counterfactual modelling, or simulation.
  • Experience working with wearable sensors, IoT data, biomechanics, sports technology, or other high-frequency telemetry.
  • Experience building knowledge graphs or domain-specific ontologies.
  • Experience with LLM or AI evaluation frameworks and an understanding of their limitations.
  • Experience with AWS, including ECS, EC2, Lambda, SNS, SQS, or related services.
  • Experience with GraphQL, REST, gRPC, Postgres, MongoDB, or similar technologies.

raw.description:
Chez Shakepay, nous avons pour mission d'introduire l'âge d'or du Bitcoin. Nous réinventons les services financiers pour offrir à chaque personne au Canada sa juste part.

Notre culture repose sur l’importance de faire un travail qui compte, la collaboration et la célébration des succès communs. Si vous aimez évoluer dans un environnement où croissance, rapidité d’exécution et partage d’idées sont essentiels, rejoignez-nous pour construire l’avenir ensemble!

À propos de Shakepay

Depuis 2015, notre mission est d'aider les Canadiens à bâtir une richesse à long terme grâce au bitcoin. Au cours des dernières années, nous avons élargi nos activités au-delà de l'achat et de la vente de bitcoins pour offrir une gamme croissante de produits financiers quotidiens, notamment la carte Shakepay, le dépôt direct, le paiement de factures et le Virement Interac, ce qui facilite l'obtention, l'épargne et l'utilisation de bitcoins au quotidien. Aujourd'hui, plus de 1,5 million de Canadiens utilisent Shakepay pour faire fructifier leur épargne en bitcoins et prendre en main leur avenir financier, alors que nous continuons de repousser les limites de ce à quoi peuvent ressembler les services financiers modernes.

Nous sommes réglementés en tant que courtier en valeurs mobilières dans toutes les provinces et tous les territoires canadiens, et bénéficions du soutien de capital-risqueurs renommés, avec un financement de 44 M$. Nous avons une communauté passionnée, loyale et grandissante, et nous recherchons des personnes qui veulent nous aider à construire quelque chose de vraiment spécial.

Partenaire principal·e en opérations RH

À propos du rôle

Nous recherchons un·e partenaire principal·e, opérations RH pour nous aider à rehausser la barre en matière de gestion des ressources humaines.

C’est l’occasion de rejoindre une fonction RH dotée de bases solides et de contribuer à façonner l’avenir. Vous apporterez un regard neuf sur les systèmes, les processus et les programmes qui soutiennent les employés et les gestionnaires, en contribuant à les rendre plus clairs, cohérents et faciles à faire évoluer à mesure que Shakepay se développe.

Vous interviendrez à toutes les étapes du cycle de vie des employés, contribuerez à des programmes clés en ressources humaines et collaborerez avec les gestionnaires et les équipes interfonctionnelles pour prendre des décisions liées aux ressources humaines. Il s’agit d’un poste senior de contributeur individuel, très axé sur l’exécution, destiné à une personne qui aime se plonger dans les détails, qui sait repérer les occasions d’améliorer ce qui existe déjàet qui transforme les bonnes idées en solutions concrètes.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Assumer la responsabilité de la gestion quotidienne des processus clés liés aux ressources humaines tout au long du cycle de vie des employés, notamment l’intégration, les départs, les congés, les avantages sociaux, les données sur les employés, la documentation et les systèmes RH.
  • Concevoir, documenter et améliorer des flux de travail, des transferts de responsabilités fluides et des ressources fiables qui facilitent la gestion et la mise à jour des processus RH.
  • Appuyer la mise en œuvre opérationnelle des principaux programmes RH, notamment les cycles d’évaluation du rendement et de rémunération, et contribuer à améliorer leur fonctionnement au fil du temps.
  • Proposer des recommandations claires, des options, des compromis et des prochaines étapes lorsque la voie à suivre n’est pas évidente.
  • Utiliser les données, la rétroaction des employés et l’expérience quotidienne pour cerner les risques, les tendances et les occasions d’amélioration, de simplification et d’automatisation.
  • Collaborer avec les services des finances, des affaires juridiques, de la sécurité, de la gestion des talents et les fournisseurs externes sur les projets liés aux ressources humaines.
  • Contribuer à renforcer la continuité au sein de la fonction en créant une documentation claire, des processus reproductibles et un système de relève efficace.

Profil recherché

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience progressive dans les opérations RH, le partenariat RH, les fonctions RH généralistes ou un poste connexe dans le domaine des ressources humaines.
  • Expérience de travail autonome dans plusieurs volets des ressources humaines, au sein d’un environnement dynamique, en constante évolution ou au sein d’une équipe réduite.
  • Expérience pratique dans l’accompagnement du cycle de vie des employés et dans l’utilisation des systèmes RH, des données sur les employés, de la documentation et des processus opérationnels.
  • Expérience dans la contribution à la gestion du rendement, à la rémunération, à l’intégration et au départ des employés, à l’élaboration de politiques, à l’accompagnement des gestionnaires ou à d’autres programmes RH à l’échelle de l’entreprise.
  • Connaissance concrète des normes du travail et des pratiques d’emploi canadiennes et bon jugement quant au moment où il convient de faire appel au service juridique ou à des conseillers externes.
  • Antécédents avérés en matière d’amélioration des processus, de création de méthodes de travail plus claires et de transformation de problèmes récurrents en systèmes plus efficaces.
  • Bon jugement, discrétion, aptitude à la communication et suivi rigoureux, notamment lors du traitement de questions sensibles concernant les employés.
  • Capacité à établir des priorités parmi des besoins concurrents, à faire des compromis pratiques et à faire avancer le travail sans supervision étroite.
  • Maîtrise professionnelle de l'anglais.

Points bonus

  • Expérience de l’utilisation d’outils modernes de SIRH, de gestion des ressources humaines, de gestion des flux de travail ou d’automatisation.
  • Expérience de l’utilisation d’outils d’automatisation et d’intelligence artificielle pour réduire les tâches administratives récurrentes tout en protégeant la confidentialité et l’exactitude des données.
  • Expérience en matière de structures de rémunération, d’analyses comparatives, de classification des postes ou de cadres de carrière.
  • Expérience dans le soutien au renouvellement des avantages sociaux ou à la gestion des relations avec les fournisseurs.
  • Expérience de travail au sein d’une entreprise technologique, d’une fintech, d’une start-up ou d’une entreprise en pleine croissance.
  • Expérience dans le soutien aux employés partout au Canada.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • 🚀 Façonnez l’avenir de la finance :Rejoignez une équipe qui révolutionne les services financiers au Canada, un sat à la fois.
  • 🌎 Ayez un impact à grande échelle :Alors que les cryptomonnaies continuent de se démocratiser, notre potentiel de croissance est immense. Aidez-nous à mettre Shakepay et le Bitcoin à la portée de tous les Canadiens.
  • 📈 Faites évoluer votre carrière :Nous grandissons, et vous aussi ! Nous avons mis en place des programmes pour encourager l’apprentissage continu, le développement personnel et professionnel.
  • 💡 Des idées, pas des titres : Chez Shakepay, les meilleures idées l’emportent, peu importe d’où elles viennent.

Avantages

  • 🤝 Devenez actionnaire : Chaque employé dispose d'options d'achat d'actions dans le cadre de sa rémunération.
  • 🥅 Atteignez vos objectifs : Évaluations salariales annuelles.
  • 🦷Santé et bien-être : Accès à une couverture santé et dentaire, y compris des comptes de dépenses de santé et de bien-être.
  • 🌎 Adapté au télétravail : Travaillez de n'importe où au Canada, avec un accès facultatif à nos bureaux à Montréal et Toronto.
  • 🆙 Passez à un niveau supérieur : Un budget annuel de 2 000 $ pour les cours, les certifications et la formation afin de soutenir la croissance de votre carrière.
  • 🌴 Vacances : 20 jours de vacances par année. Et si vous utilisez toutes vos vacances, nous vous offrons une prime de 1 000 $.
  • 🐣 Congé parental: Bénéficiez d'un complément de congé parental jusqu’à 100 % de votre salaire pendant 18 semaines.
  • 🙌 S'amuser ensemble : Des sorties trimestrielles pour les équipes ou l'ensemble de l'entreprise afin de favoriser les contacts en personne.

La fourchette salariale de base pour ce poste est de 130,000 $ CA à 175,000 $ CA. Le salaire de base peut varier en fonction de facteurs tels que les années d'expérience, les compétences et les qualifications. De plus, les employés sont admissibles à des actions, à des augmentations de salaire basées sur la performance, à des avantages sociaux, y compris les soins de santé et dentaires, et à des congés payés.

Nous savons que le potentiel est tout aussi précieux que l'expérience. Si vous avez envie d’apprendre, de progresser et de contribuer à notre mission, mais que vous doutez de répondre à tous les critères, posez votre candidature quand même ! Nous encourageons toutes les candidatures, peu importe votre parcours ou vos expériences de vie. Nous croyons fermement qu'une légère inclinaison compense une ordonnée à l'origine élevée.

Nous utilisons la technologie, y compris l'intelligence artificielle (IA), pour soutenir certaines parties de notre processus d'embauche. Cela peut inclure des outils qui aident à la planification, à l'examen des candidatures, aux communications avec les candidats et à la génération de notes, de guides ou de résumés d'entrevues afin que notre équipe puisse rester concentrée sur la conversation. Toutes les décisions d'embauche sont prises par notre équipe de recrutement.

La maîtrise de l’anglais est requise en raison du pourcentage de clients anglophones et de la nature de notre plateforme, qui est accessible à tous les Canadiens.

raw.excerpt: About Us:We’re a fast-growing, privately held insurance company on a path to become a leading U.
raw.description:
About Us:

We’re a fast-growing, privately held insurance company on a path to become a leading U.S. retail platform. We believe every client and customer relationship holds the potential to grow into something greater—and the same is true for our people. As we grow, we’re redefining how great talent connects with meaningful work—enabling our ambitious strategy while building a culture of high performance, creativity, and partnership. If you’re curious about how legal strategy shapes product development and distribution in the life insurance industry, then this role offers the opportunity to advise on high-impact initiatives while guiding business through complex regulatory and risk considerations. About the Role We are seeking an experienced Actuary to lead end-to-end actuarial processes, including model development, valuation, financial reporting, and earnings projections across U.S. GAAP, Statutory, Tax, and Bermuda Economic Balance Sheet (EBS) frameworks. This role will play a critical part in supporting financial reporting, business planning, model governance, and strategic initiatives while partnering closely with Finance, Risk, Underwriting, and M&A teams. What You'll Do Valuation & Financial Reporting

  • Perform quarterly and annual valuations of insurance liabilities under U.S. GAAP, Statutory, Tax, and Bermuda EBS frameworks.
  • Analyze and explain reserve movements and actual-to-expected (A/E) earnings variances.
  • Support financial reporting activities, including disclosures and management reporting.
  • Develop and maintain earnings projections to support business planning and financial analysis.

Modeling & Systems

  • Convert existing valuation models from ArcVal to ALFA and develop new product valuation models.
  • Develop, enhance, and maintain actuarial models used for valuation and projection purposes.
  • Ensure models are accurate, efficient, and aligned with regulatory and business requirements.
  • Drive automation, process improvements, and modeling best practices.

Assumptions, Analysis & Governance

  • Develop, review, and update key actuarial assumptions, including mortality, lapse, and expense assumptions.
  • Conduct experience studies, sensitivity testing, and scenario analyses.
  • Provide insight into earnings volatility, reserve adequacy, and capital impacts.
  • Establish and maintain strong controls over models, data, and valuation processes.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation and ensure compliance with actuarial standards, internal policies, and regulatory requirements.

Business Partnership & Strategic Support

  • Partner with Underwriting, Finance, Risk, and M&A teams on product development, reinsurance transactions, and strategic initiatives.
  • Support the pricing, evaluation, and structuring of reinsurance transactions.
  • Provide actuarial expertise and insights to support business decision-making.

Audit & Regulatory Support

  • Support internal and external audits through preparation of documentation and responses to review requests.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and recommend enhancements to valuation and reporting practices as needed.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5+ years of actuarial experience with exposure to a broad range of insurance products.

Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

Scope of the Role:

At Innodata, we’re partnering with the world’s leading technology companies to build the future of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re on the lookout for a smart, savvy, and curious Generative AI Specialist to join our global contributor community as part of our Subject Matter Expert (SME) on Demand program.

This is not a traditional full-time role. It’s a part-time, remote, flexible, project-specific opportunity designed for those who want to make a real impact—on their schedule. Whether you're a writer, linguist, educator, researcher, or just deeply passionate about language and logic, this role lets you contribute to cutting-edge AI development while maintaining control over your time.

You’ll be helping LLMs learn the intricacies of language and reasoning—not just how to write, but how to think. If you’ve ever dreamed of shaping the intelligence behind tomorrow’s technology, this is your chance.

This is more than just a gig—it’s a rare chance to help shape the future of AI from anywhere in the world, on your own terms.

What You’ll Own:

  • Rating/assessing the performance of AI models or algorithms based on their output or behavior through a set of evaluative questions.
  • Labeling elements of a piece of content rather than the content as a whole.
  • Assigning predefined categories or labels to items.
  • Evaluating the perceived quality and/or appropriateness of content
  • Generating labels to advance understanding of a concept, trend etc.
  • Creation of additional training data for machine learning models by applying transformations to the original data, such as modifying images (rotation, flipping, cropping), generating new text (paraphrasing, summarization), or altering audio/video signals (speed modification, pitch shifting) to reduce overfitting and increase dataset diversity.
  • Reviewing data and identifying whether or not a product feature works as intended based on the project's guidelines.
  • Labeling model outputs to identify if a piece of content is or isn't something. Examples: identify clickbait; identifying gaming videos; identifying branded content.
  • Ordering or ranking items based on a set of preferences or criteria.
  • Creating prompts or questions that will be used to generate responses from a language model or other AI system.
  • Projects that evaluate the relevance of content based on a relevancy scale (1-3, 1-5, etc.).
  • Generating responses to prompts or questions using a language model or other AI system.
  • Rewriting existing text while preserving the original meaning, often to improve clarity or style and adherence to guidelines.
  • Producing concise summaries of longer pieces of text or data.
  • Converting spoken language or audio content into written text.
  • Converting text or spoken language from one language to another.
  • Gathering and compiling various forms of data to be used for training, evaluating, or fine-tuning the AI models. This may include text, images, videos, audio files, or other types of digital content.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Have:

  • A Bachelor’s degree or higher in a humanities specialization is required. Advanced degrees are strongly preferred (Master’s or PhD)
  • Professional or Expert level proficiency (C1/C2) in English

The expected hourly salary range for this position is $15 p/hour, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

The extraordinary AlphaSense Sales team is split into two parts: Financial Services and Corporates. The Financial Services Sales Team focuses on sales to hedge funds, asset management, investment banking, and private equity. Corporate Sales is verticalized with a focus on the Fortune 1000 across Life Sciences, Technology, Media and Telecom, Energy and Industrials, Consulting, and Consumer Packaged Goods. We are looking for an entrepreneurial, driven, and coachable new business sales professional to join our growing Strategic Accounts team as an Associate Account Executive. Working under the direction of a Global Account Director, you will contribute to a larger team quota while learning from senior sales leaders and subject matter experts who sell into some of the world's most influential companies. This is an opportunity to build on your existing sales experience, develop the skills to manage complex enterprise sales cycles, and sell an award-winning, AI-driven product experiencing rapid adoption across every industry vertical. The person in this role will make a meaningful contribution to the company's growth and future success.

Who You Are:

  • Ready for the next step: You have a track record of success in a SaaS or non-SaaS sales environment and want to grow into complex, enterprise-level selling.
  • Strategic and curious: You know the right questions to ask and how to uncover business challenges at all levels of an organization, from Analysts to senior executives.

  • Prospecting & Pipeline: Research opportunities, prospect, initiate discussions, build relationships, conduct demos, manage product trials, and most importantly: close deals. Partner with our SDR and Marketing teams on account-based prospecting plans to drive pipeline.
  • Strategic Account Planning: Map large, matrixed organizations, identify whitespace across business units, and build multi-threaded relationships up to senior stakeholders.
  • Forecasting: Forecast accurately and develop the pipeline necessary to meet or exceed quota.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with our Product Specialist team during trials to drive client engagement and ultimate purchase, and with Account Management to ensure customer health and close sourced upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
  • Voice of the Customer: Gather and share product feedback from clients and prospects with the sales and product teams to help us continually enhance our offerings.

We offer a competitive benefits program, a generous commission plan with uncapped earning potential as well as equity.

$79,000—$109,000 USD

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. Our backers

Initialized Capital, Better Tomorrow Ventures, Abstract Ventures, New Form Capital, QED Investors, Valor Capital and Quona Capital, along with the founders of Flutterwave, Chipper Cash, Rappi, Pomelo, Dock, Remesa Online and Anchorage.

About the role

We're hiring a Customer Success Manager who can sell. You will own a portfolio of 10–20 B2B customers across Brazil & the Southern Cone, keep them live and happy, and grow them through upsell and expansion. Retention is the floor; account growth is how this role is measured. This is a "0 to 1" role: you won't just follow a playbook, you'll help write it. You'll report to the Head of Customer Success and work closely with BD, Product, Engineering, Operations and Compliance.

What you'll do

  • Proactively identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities across Caliza's products (USD accounts, FX, stablecoin on/off-ramps, global payouts) to grow each customer's revenue and transaction volume, and own your portfolio's expansion and NRR targets.
  • Lead and resolve commercial discussions with your customers, including pricing, renewals, contract expansions and other terms, in coordination with Revenue and leadership.
  • Lead customers from technical kickoff to go-live and recurring volume, and resolve issues with payment flows, API integrations and account management.
  • Use data to track customer health, flag churn risk or volume drops early, and keep account activity and pipeline up to date.
  • Act as the voice of the Brazilian customer within Caliza, translating local market needs into product features with BD, Product and Engineering.

What you'll bring

  • 5–7 years in Customer Success, Account Management or Implementation at a high-growth fintech, payments or B2B SaaS company.
  • A proven track record of hitting expansion, upsell or account growth targets. Please share the numbers: quota or target, attainment, and how you grew your accounts.
  • Comfort working with APIs and explaining technical concepts to developers and business stakeholders.
  • Deep understanding of the Brazilian financial landscape and payments (Pix, FX, local regulations).
  • A commercial mindset: you see every customer conversation as a chance to add value and grow the relationship.
  • Low ego and proactive cross-functional communication, with the ability to translate complex requirements into simple actionable plans.
  • Comfort with ambiguous, fast-paced, resource-constrained environments, and excitement to build from the ground up.
  • Excellent follow-through: always following up, never letting opportunities slip, and closing the loop.
  • Native Portuguese and fluent English.
  • Based in Brazil, with the ability to overlap a few hours a day with US Eastern time.

Benefits

Benefits vary by country of employment and may include health coverage, paid time off and holidays, a home office or equipment allowance, a professional development budget, and in-person team offsites. Candidates based outside the US may be employed through an employer of record or engaged as contractors, with pay and benefits structured to local law and market practice.

Equal opportunity and other disclosures

Equal opportunity employer. Caliza is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We value diverse backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every listed qualification.

Accommodations. We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants with disabilities and to anyone who needs one during the hiring process. To request an accommodation, contact the recruiting team.

Background screening. Because we handle sensitive financial data and regulated activity, any offer will be contingent on a background check, which may include criminal history, employment and education verification, and sanctions screening, to the extent permitted by law. In the US, we conduct screening in line with the Fair Credit Reporting Act and applicable state and local fair chance laws, and we consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with those laws.

Work authorization. Candidates must be authorized to work in their country of residence. We are not able to sponsor visas for this role.

Employment terms. For US-based hires, employment with Caliza is at-will. Terms for hires outside the US follow local law.

Applicant privacy. We collect and process applicant personal data solely for purposes of evaluating applications and managing the recruitment process in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), Brazil’s General Data Protection Law (LGPD), Mexico’s Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP), the European Union’s General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), and the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (NDPA). We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for these purposes or as required by applicable law. Subject to applicable legal requirements, applicants may request access to, correction or deletion of their personal data, as well as exercise other applicable rights, including restricting or objecting to processing and requesting data portability.

Use of AI in hiring. We may use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications or assessing responses. These tools assist our team but do not replace human judgment, and final hiring decisions are made by people.

Recruitment fraud. Caliza will never ask candidates for payment, banking details, or cryptocurrency during the hiring process. Official communications come only from Caliza email addresses. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from us, please report it to our team.

raw.description:
Do you have experience analysing commercial performance within the telecommunications industry?
We're looking for a Commercial Insights Analyst who understands the drivers of growth in telecoms markets and can turn customer, product and commercial data into actionable business decisions.
You'll also help us better understand our customers by analysing behaviour, usage patterns and market trends, creating performance dashboards and segmentation models that identify opportunities for acquisition, retention, upsell and revenue growth. Alongside this, you'll monitor competitor activity and industry developments, translating insight into practical actions that strengthen JT's market position and customer propositions.
Success in this role requires strong analytical capability, commercial awareness and the confidence to engage with stakeholders at all levels of the business. You'll be responsible for producing executive-level reporting and presentations, simplifying complex information into clear, actionable insights that support decision-making across Commercial Leadership and strategic governance forums.
This role is ideally suited to someone who has worked within a telecommunications, connectivity or subscription-based business in a commercial insights, analytics or performance management capacity, with experience analysing customer acquisition, retention, churn, ARPU, pricing performance and commercial outcomes.
JT is committed to building a diverse and inclusive working environment and JT Family. We will ensure that all individuals are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in job applications, interviews, onboarding processes and beyond. Should you require any support or assistance in making your application, please contact us at .

What you'll do

1. Develop and maintain annual budgets, forecasts and commercial plans for the Consumer and Small Business portfolio, monitoring performance against plan and identifying variances, risks and corrective actions.
2. Monitor and analyse customer, product, revenue, margin, ARPU, acquisition and churn performance, identifying trends, opportunities and risks and recommending actions to improve commercial outcomes.
3. Evaluate the performance of products, propositions and commercial initiatives, identifying opportunities to improve customer value, revenue growth and market competitiveness.
4. Conduct scenario analysis and commercial modelling to assess the impact of pricing changes, product developments, market trends and strategic initiatives.
5. Create and maintain customer segmentation models and performance dashboards to identify opportunities for acquisition, retention, upsell and revenue growth.
6. Analyse customer behaviour, usage patterns and purchasing trends to generate actionable insights supporting product, marketing and digital initiatives.
7. Monitor competitor activity, market developments and industry trends, translating insights into recommendations that strengthen commercial performance and customer value propositions.
8. Monitor competitor activity, market developments and industry trends across the telecommunications sector, translating insights into recommendations that strengthen commercial performance and customer value propositions.
9. Provide constructive commercial challenge, ensuring business proposals, initiatives and investment decisions are supported by robust analysis and sound commercial rationale.
10. Support the development of business cases, commercial assessments and recommendations for new products, propositions and strategic initiatives.
11. Support the development of business cases, commercial assessments and recommendations for new products, propositions, pricing initiatives and strategic investments.
12. Build trusted stakeholder relationships across Commercial, Finance and Operational teams, acting as a valued business partner and advisor.
13. Identify emerging commercial risks and opportunities, proactively highlighting areas requiring management intervention.
14. Drive improvements in reporting, analytical methodologies and performance measurement frameworks to support effective decision-making.

What we're looking for

• Experience working within telecommunications, mobile, broadband, connectivity or subscription-based markets in a commercial insights, commercial analytics, business intelligence, business analysis or performance management role
• Experience analysing consumer telecoms customer behaviour, acquisition, retention, revenue, margin and product performance to support commercial decision making
• Experience in commercial planning, forecasting, business case development and performance management
• Strong analytical and commercial modelling skills, with the ability to evaluate opportunities, assess risks and provide actionable recommendations
• Advanced Excel skills and experience with reporting and visualisation tools such as Power BI
• Experience interpreting and presenting data from multiple sources to create meaningful commercial insights and management information
• Strong commercial awareness, with the ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations and actions
• Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively and engage senior leaders
• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex information for a variety of audiences
• Knowledge of telecommunications markets, products, customer drivers and the wider competitive landscape

Benefits

· 24 days holiday
· Health & Dental Insurance
· Pension Scheme
· Bonus Scheme
· Fully discounted staff services or cash allowance in lieu
· Co-working office spaces available for remote employees
· Professional Development
· Recharge Days
JT provide colleagues with an opportunity to embrace flexibility to work the hours that suit them in a location of their choice – office, home or further afield under our Hybrid Working guidelines.

Through our hybrid working initiative we have diversified the ways in which we recruit, which also means that we are now able to support posts in major global locations. The benefits that are listed above are an example of those that we provide in our key locations, if you are applying from outside of these areas, please note that your compensation package might look a little different.

Our main priority is colleague wellbeing, and we hope this offers greater opportunity for a work life balance. We aim to offer this approach to all colleagues across the business, but we recognise that there are certain roles that will need to work in a specific way due to their nature, such as our colleagues working in engineering, our contact centres and our retail outlets. We are actively working with our management teams to increase flexibility wherever we can.

TELUS Digital AI Community

Every day, billions of people search for music, shows, and apps across global platforms. They type a query expecting to find exactly what they're looking for. But those search results only make sense if AI understands not just the words people search for, but the cultural meaning behind them. Your deep knowledge of how people in your market actually consume media — which shows matter to which communities, how music preferences shift across regions, what streaming platforms mean to your culture — is the bridge between what people search for and what algorithms learn to recommend. That cultural translation is irreplaceable.

A Day in the Life of a Media Search Analyst

In this role, you will evaluate how well media search results align with real user intent across multiple search modalities. Your analytical judgment determines whether AI systems understand not just what people search for, but why they search, and whether the results truly serve their cultural and entertainment context.

  • Parse complex media intent queries across streaming platforms, music catalogs, and application ecosystems understanding that the same search term carries different meaning across regions and age groups

  • Validate multilingual asset metadata and cross-attribute search parameters (release dates, artist affiliations, regional availability, cultural context)

  • Evaluate search result relevance against detailed evaluation frameworks that account for local market nuance, regional preferences, and cultural interpretation

  • Apply structured reasoning to edge cases where metadata conflicts or cultural context shifts meaning

  • Provide detailed assessment feedback that trains media search algorithms to better reflect local culture and user intent

Why this matters: When media search algorithms understand local culture, discovery becomes accurate and meaningful. Listeners find the right music, viewers discover relevant shows, and cultural expression is reflected authentically in digital systems. ﻿

This is an AI engineering role with a forward-deployed edge. You'll split your time between:

2. Deploying them with clients: working embedded with real estate private equity funds, institutional investors and family offices to solve their hardest problems with AI
You write production code, ship it and own it. On client work you partner with our GTM team: they open the door and frame the problem, you scope, build and deploy the solution. What you learn in the field goes straight back into the platform, so every deployment makes the product better.

raw.excerpt: Grow our AI image service. The roleWe are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency.
raw.description:
Grow our AI image service.

The role

We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.

You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

  1. The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.
  2. Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.

Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.

This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.

We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.

What we are looking for

  1. You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.
  2. You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.
  3. You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.
  4. You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.
  5. You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience

We do not ask for a number of years and we do not screen on your CV, because we decide on what you do in the trial.

Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application and a short asynchronous interview. One take, no re-records.
  2. Aptitude tests, with a published floor.
  3. A short video introduction.
  4. A verification step where we check what you have told us.
  5. A short paid screen of a few days, then a paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Requirements

  1. Full time once hired, and this is your only job. During the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 of them at a fixed time inside our working day, and you can keep your current job. If you pass, you give notice and join us full time within 30 days.
  2. Reliable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.
  3. Strong written English.
  4. Based in Indonesia.
  5. You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits

1000 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

Pass your 90-day review and your pay goes up by 50 percent. The 90 days count from the day you start full time.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus (13th month pay in the Philippines and South Africa, THR in Indonesia).
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.

Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

Role Overview

The Senior Application Security Engineer is a senior individual contributor responsible for strengthening Apollo’s secure software development lifecycle and reducing application risk across product, platform, and AI-powered features.

This role blends deep code-level application security work with strong cross-functional partnership. It includes application security reviews, threat modeling, AppSec tooling, findings triage and remediation follow-through, external testing intake, and developer enablement.

This role is calibrated at the L6 senior-IC level: owning semi-annual or annual goals, solving ambiguous problems with sound judgment, improving operational processes, and driving meaningful cross-team collaboration and influence.

Secure SDLC, design review, and threat modeling

  • Own and continuously improve the secure software development lifecycle for Apollo applications so security is embedded into design, implementation, and deployment.
  • Perform application security reviews, threat modeling, and deep code-level analysis for high-impact product, platform, and AI features before launch.
  • Provide practical security architecture guidance to Engineering, Product, and IT teams
  • Help define and maintain application-security guardrails, secure design expectations, code review standards, and risk models for new and existing systems.

Vulnerability management and hands-on remediation

  • Drive execution-heavy vulnerability management across internal reviews, bug bounty, pentests, SCA/runtime findings, and other research signals, ensuring findings are validated, prioritized, routed clearly, and tracked through remediation and verification within SLAs.
  • Go beyond identifying issues: read the code, explain root cause, propose the safest fix, and directly implement or support remediation when needed for complex vulnerabilities.
  • Perform hands-on validation and offensive security testing of applications and fixes, including exploit development, bypass testing, adversarial thinking, and focused red-team-style exercises, to confirm remediations address the underlying issue rather than only the initial symptom.
  • Work across the kinds of application security issues common in modern SaaS environments, including authentication and authorization weaknesses, access control risks, OAuth and CSRF design flaws, SSRF, cryptographic and verification issues, information disclosure and data exposure risks, unsafe execution and deserialization patterns, and dependency or runtime vulnerabilities.
  • Apply clear, risk-based severity decisions using exploitability, data sensitivity, customer impact, and blast radius

Tooling, automation, and AI

  • Configure and improve AppSec tooling and integrations, including SAST configuration, ignore lists, dashboards, and other controls that maintain useful coverage without excessive noise.
  • Select, build, or refine security tooling, small automations, and workflow enrichments that reduce manual effort and scale AppSec operations responsibly.
  • Use AI to automate, transform, and scale security and engineering-adjacent processes where it materially improves speed, consistency, or signal quality, while still validating outputs with strong engineering judgment.
  • Embed AI-specific security checks into SSDLC reviews and code analysis, including input and output handling, AI-exposed APIs, prompt and response guardrails, and abuse or data-exfiltration paths.
  • Partner cross-functionally on AI security requirements and controls so AI systems and AI-powered features are designed, deployed, and operated securely.

Engineering enablement and partnership

  • Support and scale security enablement for engineers and security champions, including secure coding, AppSec, and AI-safety content.
  • Provide actionable remediation guidance, secure patterns, and examples that help engineering teams fix issues quickly and correctly.
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Product, Platform, Data, Legal, and other security teams to keep AppSec priorities aligned with business risk and product velocity.
  • Produce clear documentation, metrics, and written narratives that improve AppSec visibility, observability, and decision-making.

What Good Looks Like

  • Owns meaningful AppSec goals over a semi-annual or annual horizon and independently identifies the right solutions to ambiguous, open-ended problems.
  • Drives cross-team collaboration and operational improvements beyond isolated tickets or one-off reviews
  • Makes informed decisions by balancing technical detail, business context, customer trust, and long-term risk
  • Sets a high bar for ownership, communication, mentoring, and technical judgment, and helps raise the effectiveness of peers and partner teams.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of software engineering or application security experience, with meaningful hands-on AppSec depth in modern SaaS environments.
  • Strong software development skills and the ability to read, write, and ship production code; Ruby experience is highly valuable, and Python or similar scripting ability is a plus.
  • Strong Linux and cloud fundamentals, ideally with experience in GCP-backed environments.
  • Deep familiarity with common AppSec issues, secure design, secure authentication and authorization patterns, vulnerability management, and developer security tooling.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform deep code review, penetration testing, and exploit-oriented validation, and to either fix vulnerabilities directly or work closely with engineers to land durable remediations that hold up against bypass attempts and variant analysis.
  • Experience handling findings from bug bounty, pentests, internal reviews, or automated security tooling through closure and verification.
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools, automations, APIs, or structured workflows to improve engineering or security processes at scale.
  • Experience securing AI-powered systems or features, including AI API exposure, prompt and response handling, data protection, misuse scenarios, and monitoring expectations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills across technical and non-technical partners.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting or leading security reviews for AI-native products, internal agents, or AI-assisted engineering workflows.
  • Experience improving secure-by-design practices and AppSec observability in a fast-moving engineering organization
  • Experience with security training, developer enablement, or security champions programs
  • Relevant security certifications are a plus

Example Success Outcomes

  • Improve the health and flow of AppSec findings by keeping prioritization, remediation, and verification moving within defined SLAs.
  • Complete recurring application reviews or threat models for important systems and features
  • Increase engineering adoption of secure patterns, AppSec tooling, and security training
  • Reduce manual toil and improve AppSec signal quality through targeted automation and responsible use of AI-assisted workflows.

Description

🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We're looking for the person who brings a Forward Deployed Engineering curriculum to life for students: you would be part of a team of senior authors who help create the content for the course. The best person for this is someone who has actually gone into client environments and carried AI deployments to production, has opinions about what a sound deployment looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their approach is wrong.

Your audience: Working production engineers, not career changers, with six to fifteen years in, mostly backend, with senior and staff engineers and the occasional engineering manager. They've shipped real software for years and are moving deliberately into forward-deployed AI work; some are already interviewing for FDE roles while they study. What they're missing is agentic systems and the client-facing half of delivery.

Format: asynchronous, estimated 20 hrs/week.

Please submit all resumes or CVs in English.

What you will do

  • Design and build the projects students work on end to end — scope, learning goals, technical infrastructure, environments, and supporting databases or datasets.
  • Write clear submission guidelines and assessment criteria (rubrics) that reviewers can apply consistently.
  • Work closely with Learning Experience Designers to make projects and lessons educationally sound and engaging: refining wording, pacing, and difficulty calibration across the course.
  • Research, evaluate, and sign off on technical solutions and tooling so the curriculum stays current and relevant to what employers actually use.
  • Contribute to sales and marketing enablement — training commercial teams on what the course covers and what graduates can do.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional engineering experience, currently working at senior level or above (Senior/Lead/Staff Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or technical lead on customer-facing delivery).
  • Has personally owned deployments end-to-end in real client or enterprise environments – first call through production go-live and adoption.
  • Practical experience with databases and the infrastructure needed to run student projects (cloud environments, containers, version control, CI where relevant).
  • Ability to break complex technical work into scoped, assessable tasks at a defined difficulty level.
  • Strong written communication in English — you'll produce a lot of instructional text and it needs to be unambiguous.
  • Comfort collaborating cross-functionally with instructional design, and explaining technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience mentoring, teaching, tutoring, or reviewing others' code.

Preferred experience:

  • Prior EdTech or rubric/assessment design experience.

What we can offer you

  • Fully remote work.
  • A digital office: we use modern tools (Notion, Slack, Zoom) to keep collaboration smooth.
  • Professional trust and autonomy: no micromanaging.
  • A diverse, international, close-knit team excited to work with you!

Our work spans design, engineering, manufacturing, and field deployment. We partner with OEMs, fabricators, and technology leaders to accelerate delivery of efficient, scalable solutions for hyperscale, colocation, and AI/HPC markets.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: Senior Electrical Application Engineer Position

Location: Remote – work virtually from anywhere in the United States Travel

Requirements: Up to 25%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states.

Must be able to rent vehicles and have a valid driver’s license.

JOB SUMMARY: This is a senior-level, hands-on application engineering role. You will own electrical application engineering for Galtra’s prefabricated platforms, bridging customer requirements, technical design, and vendor execution. You will operate as a senior individual contributor with clear ownership of electrical configuration, integration assumptions, and execution readiness. This role does not serve as Engineer of Record. Final stamped designs remain with the EOR and owner appointed engineers. Electrical systems depth is essential. Working knowledge of mechanical systems, controls, and automation is a strong advantage. Candidates who can operate across disciplines, make informed technical tradeoffs, and translate between design intent, manufacturing realities, and operational constraints will be highly favored. This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

  • Own electrical application engineering for Galtra prefabricated platforms through design freeze, including configuration tradeoffs, vendor assumptions, and cost-risk recommendations.
  • Lead development of prefabricated electrical systems such as power distribution centers (PDCs), switchgear lineups, MCCs, UPS-integrated systems, and packaged controls assemblies.
  • Translate customer one-lines, specifications, and sequences of operation into manufacturable, scalable solutions with defined configurations, options, and alternates.

  • Develop vendor-ready electrical requirement packages and resolve technical clarifications; Galtra Solutions, LLC © 2026 confidential & proprietary Senior Electrical Application Engineer commercial terms and lead-time negotiation remain with Sales and Supply Chain.

TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS

raw.title: Staff Software Engineer
raw.excerpt: OAG is the essential intelligence partner transforming global travel.
raw.description:
OAG is the essential intelligence partner transforming global travel. For nearly a century, we've been the foundation the travel industry builds on, trusted, proven, essential. Today, we're going beyond.

We combine unmatched data quality, quantity and access with breakthrough technology and deep industry expertise to deliver what the industry truly needs: not just more data, but better answers. From real-time operational intelligence to strategic decision-making, we power the entire travel ecosystem, from airlines and airports to technology companies and financial institutions. We are actively embedding AI throughout our intelligence layer, combining nearly a century of proprietary data with the latest technology to deliver answers that were simply not possible before. We exist because travel moves the world, and we move travel. By transforming complexity into clarity and questions into answers, we give our partners the intelligence they need to thrive in an evolving world. For more information visit

ABOUT THE ROLE:

OAG Digital is the team turning our world-class data into a product-led growth engine: a unified experience where customers can discovery, try, pay and use on their own. We build the platform customers use to find, buy and use our data, and the intelligence products that turn that data into answers.

This is the most senior individual contributor role on the technical side of Digital. Its purpose is to turn the Digital strategy into a technical strategy that delivers it: deciding what gets built, in what order and to what standard, so the business can sell what it has committed to sell. A decision taken in one team should still work in another, our promises to customers on access, security, reliability and cost should hold on every channel, and the hardest problems should get solved once.

You’ll work across two areas. Core is the platform backbone: identity, auth, entitlements, billing, usage metering and the infrastructure everything else depends on. Intelligence is the layer above the data: AI-powered insights, predictive models built on Databricks and Snowflake, anomaly detection, and agentic features.

The role is hands-on. You’ll write production code on the hardest parts of the platform while setting direction, reviewing designs and helping other engineers do better work. We care about UX as much as throughput, and we’re AI-native: tooling is part of how we develop, not an afterthought.

This role can be worked remotely from anywhere in the UK only. Please note that we’re unable to offer visa sponsorship, so applicants will need the existing right to work in the UK.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

  • Design and build the hardest parts of the platform, hands on: how customers get to the right data and products, how that access is controlled, and what it costs us to serve. Stay close enough to the code that the design still holds once it’s built
  • Set the technical direction for problems that cross team boundaries: how customers are identified, what they’re allowed to use, how usage is measured and charged, and how existing customers and older systems move onto the new platform. Write the design down, get agreement, and stay with it through delivery so teams build to one approach rather than several
  • Set the standard for products built on AI and machine learning: define what a feature must do before it ships (show where its answer came from, be honest about how current the data is, fail predictably, be tested repeatably). Set the technical brief for data science teams, including how a model will be judged and the speed and cost it has to work within, and push back when a model isn’t the right tool
  • Work with the teams and partners outside Digital who build against your designs, including other parts of OAG and third parties. Share designs early, take feedback, change course where they’re right, and make the call when a cross-team decision has been open too long
  • Integrate AI models, data pipelines and event-driven systems on Databricks and Snowflake into the Intelligence layer
  • Improve how the whole of Digital builds software: review designs and code beyond your own team, mentor senior engineers, and make the good way to do something the easy way. This includes making AI-assisted development reliable, with the checks needed to keep quality high
  • Maintain the quality bar through code reviews, automated testing, observability, and CI/CD.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Extensive experience building and running production software end to end, from system design through to operating it live
  • Technical leadership beyond a single team: a track record of influencing engineers and teams you don’t manage, and building agreement across them
  • System design across boundaries: systems that stay correct, fast and affordable when several teams, several delivery channels and a shared data platform are all involved, and sound judgement on when to solve something once centrally versus letting each team solve it
  • Hands-on experience in analytical or data-intensive contexts and depth in large-scale data platforms: how they’re built, governed and paid for, including keeping one customer’s data separate from another’s, controlling access at the data layer, tracking data lineage, and keeping query cost under control
  • Machine learning and AI in production: enough understanding of how models and agents are built, trained and evaluated to set the technical brief for the data science team, read an evaluation critically, and judge whether a result will hold up in the real world. Experience taking AI-powered features into production and making them reliable, cost-effective and trustworthy for customers.
  • Judgement under uncertainty, with commercial awareness: you understand that technical choices affect what the business can charge and what it costs to serve a customer, and you know when to decide and when to wait
  • Clear communicator who can explain direction, risk and trade-offs so that engineers, product, commercial and senior leaders all take away the same thing
  • A builder’s mindset. You understand the who and the why, and you own what ships
  • AI-native in how you build: you use AI tooling with judgement, stay current with how agentic development is evolving, and help make effective agentic practices the norm across the team

If you don’t meet every requirement but feel excited about this role, we’d still love to hear from you.

WE WILL OFFER YOU

🚀 A progressive, non-hierarchical culture where innovation drives everything we build

🏡 Flexible working arrangements that allow remote work or office attendance

💰 An attractive compensation and benefits package, including access to a Simplyhealth cash plan to support your everyday health and wellbeing, a company bonus scheme, Octopus EV salary sacrifice scheme and enhanced pension scheme

🏖️ 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, volunteering days and additional day off during your birthday month

👪 Inclusive family benefits designed to support you through parenthood and fertility journeys

🌍 Work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 1 month per year

📚 Annual learning and development budget.

OAG is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and able to perform at their best.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We are happy to have an open conversation about how we can support you.
