raw.description:
Intradiem is reinventing customer service for everyone by helping organizations connect people, technology, and real-time action to create more agile operations and more human experiences.

Who We Are
Intradiem is the leader in Dynamic Workforce Orchestration. We help organizations create service agility by connecting people, technology, and real-time data to improve customer experiences and support employees. We believe automation should empower humans, not replace them.

What We Do
Our platform turns real-time insights into real-time action. By orchestrating work across customer service teams, we help organizations break down silos, adapt instantly to changing demand, and operate more efficiently without losing the human touch which is essential to customer service.

How We Work
We solve real operational problems alongside our customers. Our approach is practical, collaborative, and focused on outcomes. We listen first, build with purpose, and create technology solutions that work in the real world.

Our Culture
We’re proud to be a people-first company. We treat employees with trust, respect, and flexibility because great customer experiences start with supported teams. We move fast, collaborate closely, and believe the best ideas come from empowered people working together.

Our Values

We encourage our employees to contribute time and energy to causes that help improve the people and communities in which they live and work. We are guided by three core values:

Servant's Heart—We believe in caring enough about other people to understand what their problems are and placing the needs of colleagues, customers, and others over personal objectives.

Craftsman's Attitude—We believe in taking pride in the work we do and creating solutions that actually solve the problem at hand (and trying again if the first attempt doesn't do the trick).

Growth Mindset—We believe that progress comes from curiosity, openness, and perseverance. We welcome feedback, embrace change, and push beyond comfort zones to unlock new potential for ourselves, our teams, and our customers.

Curious about what it's like to work at a top Atlanta workplace? Explore more open roles and life at Intradiem.

Note: Intradiem does not use artificial intelligence (AI) or automated decision-making technology to make hiring decisions. While we use technology tools to record and transcribe interviews for better note-taking, all employment decisions—from initial resume review through final hiring—are made by human team members. Applications are reviewed and evaluated by our People Team and hiring managers, ensuring our People-First approach is reflected in every step of our candidate experience.

About the Role

The Client Partner is a senior, quota-carrying sales role responsible for forming peer-level executive relationships with senior operations and technology leaders, most often a Chief Operating Officer or SVP of Operations, within Intradiem's targeted Net New Logo enterprise accounts.

Reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer, the Client Partner leads a dedicated executive buyer's journey for full-suite Dynamic Workforce Orchestration (DWO) opportunities: engagements that span both front office and back office solutions within a single scope. This role exists to elevate every conversation to the senior executive level, sell the value of Intradiem's DWO Operational Assessment, and gain control of the sales cycle from first executive contact through close.

The Client Partner is expected to engage the way a senior partner from a top-tier management consulting or advisory firm, such as McKinsey or Deloitte, would engage: leading with researched, account-specific insight rather than a product pitch, bringing benchmark data and a clear point of view into the first conversation, and being judged on the rigor of the business case and recommendation as much as on the sale itself.

Key Responsibilities

  • Form peer-level executive relationships with senior operations and technology leaders, most often a Chief Operating Officer or SVP of Operations, within Intradiem's targeted Net New Logo enterprise accounts, leading the executive buyer's journey for full suite Dynamic Workforce Orchestration (DWO) opportunities spanning front office and back office solutions.
  • Elevate every conversation to the senior executive level and gain control of the sales cycle from first executive contact through close, engaging with the rigor of a senior partner from a top-tier management consulting or advisory firm rather than a product seller.
  • Gain VITO engagement at 30 to 50 target accounts through a coordinated multi-touch outreach plan with marketing, GTM engineering, and the outbound team, arriving at every first conversation with researched benchmarks, a point of view on the executive's likely priorities, and a specific hypothesis about where value is being left on the table.
  • Sell the value of Intradiem's DWO Operational Assessment and gain signed agreement, positioning its business case, guarantee, and time to value to secure executive commitment.
  • Run the Operational Assessment engagement with the discipline of a management consulting project: clear workstreams, an executive checkpoint cadence, and polished, data-driven deliverables.
  • Broker the introduction between the client's senior executive sponsor and Intradiem's own executive sponsor (CRO or CEO), aligning on assessment objectives, the client's mobilized team, and timing.
  • Deliver the Operational Assessment findings alongside Intradiem's consulting team, presenting baseline alignment, business case, risk assessment, cash flow analysis, key recommendations, and solution roadmap.
  • Gain agreement on next steps and communication cadence, then engage Intradiem's Account Executive, Solutions Consultant, and pre-sales team for proposal, demonstration, and contract activities.
  • Own the opportunity through close as the senior relationship owner through proposal, negotiation, and signature, staying engaged after the sale to protect the relationship and identify expansion.
  • Participate in a coordinated prospecting cadence alongside marketing, GTM engineering, and cold outreach to keep the target account pipeline moving.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience selling complex, multi-stakeholder solutions to C-suite and senior executive buyers within large enterprise accounts, with a demonstrated track record owning $10 million or larger account relationships and building $5 to $10 million or more in new business annually.
  • Experience selling workforce management, contact center technology, business process outsourcing, or enterprise SaaS solutions is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel to prospect and client sites as needed.
  • Proven ability to gain access to and build trust with senior operations executives, including Chief Operating Officers, leading consultative, value-based sales conversations at that level with genuine empathy for the executive's priorities and pressures.
  • Experience partnering with consulting or professional services teams to deliver assessment-based or diagnostic-led sales engagements; prior experience in management consulting, strategy advisory, or a comparable client-facing advisory role (for example, McKinsey, Deloitte, Accenture Strategy, or a similar firm) is a strong plus, as is a demonstrated ability to sell and engage in that same insight-led, challenger style.
  • Strong executive presence and gravitas, with the ability to represent Intradiem as a peer-level partner to a prospect's leadership team.
  • Strong financial and business acumen: comfortable building and personally defending a rigorous ROI and business case, including payback period and cost-to-serve impact, in front of a CFO-level audience.
  • Intellectually curious and strategic, with structured, hypothesis-driven problem-solving that translates a messy operational picture into a clear diagnosis, a small number of prioritized recommendations, and a defensible roadmap for where to start.
  • Executive-caliber written and verbal communication, able to build and deliver a polished, insight-led executive presentation that leads with the conclusion rather than the feature list.
  • A trusted-advisor mindset that prioritizes the client's outcome over the immediate sale, including the willingness to be direct with an executive when the data warrants it.
  • Comfort operating in a matrixed environment, coordinating internal Account Executive, Solutions Consultant, marketing, and delivery resources around a single opportunity.
  • Resourceful and resilient, with the grit to navigate long, complex executive sales cycles and keep stalled deals moving forward.

Work Authorization:Candidates must have the legal right to work in the country where the role is based at the time of application. Verification of identity and employment eligibility will be required during onboarding.

Intradiem is an equal-opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

raw.description:
Stand Together is a philanthropic community that helps America’s boldest changemakers tackle the root causes of our country’s biggest problems, from education to the economy, broken communities, and toxic division, among dozens of other pressing issues. We provide our partners with access to resources including funding, thought leadership, a network of peers, and a playbook for applying proven principles to transform lives and society.

We are seeking a bold, entrepreneurial Enterprise Architecture & Data Leader to shape how technology, data, and AI enable innovation and accelerate impact across Stand Together.

This is a unique opportunity for a strategic technology thought leader who thrives on building from the ground up, challenging conventional approaches, and turning complex technology environments into scalable, connected ecosystems.

As a member of the technology leadership team, you will establish and lead our enterprise architecture and data function, setting the direction for how systems connect, data is shared, and technology decisions are made. You will create architectural foundations, trusted data models, and reusable solutions that empower teams to move faster, innovate with confidence, and deliver greater value.

We are looking for a leader who sees architecture as an enabler of innovation, not a barrier to progress — someone who combines deep technical expertise, sound business judgment, and an entrepreneurial mindset to build what comes next.

How You Will Contribute

    • Shape Enterprise Architecture Strategy: Establish and lead enterprise architecture principles, reference architectures, decision frameworks, and technology standards that create alignment while empowering teams to innovate and execute independently.
    • Build a Trusted Enterprise Data Foundation: Define and advance the enterprise data model, including shared definitions, data ownership, quality, lineage, integration, and governance to enable reliable insights and AI-driven capabilities.
    • Create the Paved Road for Innovation: Develop reusable architecture patterns, templates, shared services, and automated controls that simplify technology decisions, accelerate delivery, and reduce unnecessary reviews.
    • Drive Strategic Technology Decisions: Establish enterprise-wide frameworks for build, buy, and reuse decisions, including the effective adoption of AI, emerging technologies, and enterprise platforms.
    • Lead Enterprise Systems Strategy: Define authoritative systems of record, guide technology rationalization, and establish architectural decision rights that reduce duplication, improve interoperability, and support long-term scalability.
    • Enable Cross-Enterprise Collaboration: Partner with Product, Platform Engineering, Security, Legal, and business leaders to translate strategic priorities into practical, secure, and scalable technology and data solutions.
    • Establish Reusable Enterprise Services:Guide the architecture and integrity of the enterprise service catalog, ensuring services are repeatable, well-defined, and designed for efficient delivery.
    • Champion Continuous Innovation: Transform recurring architecture challenges into scalable solutions, challenge outdated practices, and measure success through adoption, trusted data, faster decisions, and measurable business value.

What You Will Bring

    • Extensive experience leading enterprise architecture and data capabilities, with a demonstrated ability to translate technology strategy into measurable organizational outcomes.
    • Deep technical expertise across enterprise architecture, data modeling, data engineering, cloud platforms, system integration, security, and modern AI technologies.
    • Proven success designing and implementing enterprise-wide architecture frameworks, shared data models, reusable technology patterns, and governance practices.
    • Strong understanding of systems of record, enterprise information models, data quality, lineage, integration, and modern data platforms.
    • An entrepreneurial, builder-oriented mindset with the ability to challenge conventional thinking, navigate ambiguity, and turn strategic ideas into practical solutions.
    • Exceptional business acumen and executive-level communication skills, with the ability to influence technology direction and drive alignment across diverse stakeholders.
    • Sound architectural judgment and the confidence to make complex technology decisions while balancing innovation, security, cost, scalability, and speed.
    • A collaborative, principle-driven leadership approach that creates clarity, encourages ownership, and enables teams to make informed decisions independently.
    • Enthusiasm to contribute to Stand Together's vision and principled approach to solving problems, and a commitment to stewarding our culture, which champions values including transformation and innovation, entrepreneurialism, humility, and respect.

Standout Candidates Will Bring

    • A track record of building or transforming enterprise architecture and data functions that significantly improved technology agility, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.
    • Experience leading architecture strategy across complex, federated, or multi-entity organizations where shared standards must coexist with business autonomy.
    • Deep expertise in AI-enabled architecture, modern data ecosystems, and emerging technologies, with demonstrated success translating innovation into measurable value.
    • Experience establishing architectural decision rights, enterprise service catalogs, and automated governance that accelerate delivery rather than introduce bureaucracy.
    • Proven ability to modernize fragmented technology environments, reduce redundant systems, and create scalable foundations that support future growth.
    • A reputation as a forward-thinking technology leader who inspires innovation, challenges the status quo, and builds strong partnerships across technical and business teams.
    • A passion for applying technology and data to solve meaningful challenges and advance Stand Together's mission.

      • This is an opportunity to build, influence, and lead at the enterprise level. We are looking for a technology leader who thinks like an entrepreneur, brings the credibility of a seasoned architect, and believes the best architecture enables others to accomplish more.

What We Offer

    • Competitive benefits: Enjoy a 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting, flexible time off, comprehensive health and dental plans, plus wellness and mental health support through Peloton and Talkspace.

    • A meaningful career: Join a passionate community of over 1,400 employees dedicated to improving lives and driving innovative solutions to complex social challenges.

    • Commitment to growth: Thrive in a non-hierarchical environment that empowers employees to discover, develop and apply their unique talents.

Our Values: Working for an organization within the Stand Together philanthropic community is different from many other places. The culture is deeply rooted in Principle Based Management® (PBM®), a framework guided by the principles that drive human progress, such as dignity, openness, and bottom-up empowerment. PBM® empowers employees to be entrepreneurial, to innovate, and to continually drive transformation.
We believe diversity fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success. That is why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and strive to treat all employees and applicants with honesty, dignity, and respect.

In beiden Fällen gilt: Du hörst nicht beim Auftrag auf, sondern baust daraus Kundenbeziehungen, die über Jahre wachsen.

Dann solltest du mit uns reden.

Xantaro plant, baut und betreibt die Netze, auf denen Deutschland kommuniziert. Unsere Kunden sind die größten Carrier, Service Provider und Industrieunternehmen in Deutschland und Europa. Wir suchen Account Manager und Senior Account Manager, die Kunden übernehmen, ausbauen und neue gewinnen. Auf welchem Level du einsteigst, entscheidet deine Erfahrung, nicht dein bisheriger Titel.

  • Du verantwortest deine Accounts wie ein eigenes Unternehmen. Mit eigenen Kunden, eigenen Zielen und dem Freiraum, deine Strategie selbst zu bestimmen.
  • Du baust Beziehungen, die tragen. Vom Fachbereich bis zu CTOs, Technikvorständen und Einkaufsleitern: Du wirst der Ansprechpartner, wenn es um die Zukunft ihrer Netzinfrastruktur geht.
  • Du bringst Deals über die Ziellinie. Projekte, langfristige Rahmen- und Serviceverträge, von der ersten Qualifizierung bis zur Unterschrift.
  • Du denkst in Account-Plänen statt in Quartalen. Du identifizierst Potenziale bei Bestands- und Neukunden, entwickelst strategische Account- und Action-Pläne und setzt sie konsequent um.
  • Du verkaufst Lösungen statt Boxen. Gemeinsam mit Pre-Sales, Sales Support und unseren Maintenance Services schnürst du Pakete aus Technologie, Professional und Managed Services, etwa auf Basis von Juniper und weiteren führenden Herstellern.
  • Du verhandelst auf Augenhöhe. Angebote, Verträge, Präsentationen beim Kunden: Du führst und gewinnst.

dein profil

  • Erfahrung, die zum Level passt: Als Account Manager bringst du mindestens 2 bis 3 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb oder Account Management mit, idealerweise mit erklärungsbedürftigen IT- oder Netzwerklösungen. Als Senior hast du mindestens 5 Jahre Account Management und nachweisbare Abschlüsse bei strategischen Kunden mit großen Projektwerten.
  • Stallgeruch: Erfahrung im Carrier- und Service-Provider-Umfeld oder im Vertrieb komplexer IT- und Netzwerklösungen. Für Senior ein Muss, für Account Manager ein klarer Vorteil.
  • Ein Netzwerk, das trägt: Als Senior bringst du belastbare Kontakte zu Entscheidern bei Kunden und Herstellern mit. Als Account Manager baust du dein Netzwerk bei uns gezielt auf.
  • Methodik statt Bauchgefühl: Solution Selling, Buying-Center- und Stakeholder-Analyse, strategische Accountplanung. Erfahrung mit MEDDICC, Challenger oder ähnlichen Methoden ist ein Plus.
  • Technisches Verständnis: Du musst kein Netzwerk konfigurieren können, aber du verstehst, warum dein Kunde eines braucht, und sprichst die Sprache seiner Techniker.
  • Closer-Mentalität: Du bleibst ruhig, wenn es eng wird, behandelst Einwände souverän und bringst Deals über die Ziellinie.
  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Du handelst wie ein Owner, nicht wie ein Angestellter.
  • Sprache: verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch
  • Ausbildung: Studium oder Ausbildung (Ingenieurwesen, Elektrotechnik, Informatik, BWL o. Ä.). Am Ende zählt aber, was du erreicht hast.

wir haben mehr zu bieten als spannende jobs!

  • Echte Bühne: Accounts bei den größten Kommunikationsunternehmen Deutschlands und Europas. Du arbeitest an Projekten, die Infrastruktur für Millionen Menschen bauen.

  • Ein Team, das liefert: starkes Pre-Sales, Bid-Management, Sales Support und eigene Services im Rücken. Du verkaufst, was wir auch umsetzen können.

  • Leistung, die sich auszahlt: attraktives Fixgehalt plus leistungsorientierte variable Vergütung

  • Firmenwagen oder Car Allowance, ganz nach deiner Wahl

  • Deutschlandweit flexibel: mobiles Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten. Du organisierst dich selbst.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub, arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersvorsorge, JobRad, Urban Sports Club und Corporate Benefits

  • Kurze Wege: flache Hierarchien, direkter Draht zu Head of Sales und Geschäftsführung, schnelle Entscheidungen

  • Weiterentwicklung: gezielte Trainings, Hersteller-Zertifizierungen und ein klarer Entwicklungspfad vom Account Manager zum Senior. Und auch Senior ist bei uns keine Endstation.

Sanford Health, the largest rural health system in the United States, is dedicated to transforming the health care experience and providing access to world-class health care in America’s heartland.

Visas Accepted

H1B

Specialty

Diagnostic Radiology - Non-Interventional/Non-Invasive

Practice Details

Marshfield Medical Center is looking for a BC/BE Teleradiologist to join our Emergency Radiology working remotely or on site to cover our hospital system in Wisconsin.

•Fellowship training in Body, Neuro, ED or MSK is required.
•Must be comfortable with all emergent diagnostic imaging modalities, including Neuro CTA/perfusion, trauma (including MRI), Ultrasound (including OB), pediatrics and occasional musculoskeletal MRI/CT.
•No CVIR, nuclear medicine or mammography.

•Choose to work remotely or on site.

  • If working on site, you will need to be comfortable with and will be responsible for occasionally performing some local minor procedures.
    •Service coverage includes a level 2 hospital and stroke center as well as additional regional hospitals and urgent care centers.
    •Coverage needed for afternoons and evenings. No midnight shifts required.
    •Yearly work requirement is 182 shifts a year - typically 7 on/7 off schedule/26 weeks per year.

    We strongly encourage our physicians to be involved in medical education and research to continue building our strong foundation of patient care, research and education for years to come.

    Community Description

Nestled in the heart of Wisconsin, Marshfield is a safe, clean community with a population of about 20,000 people. The region boasts a solid economy and a low cost of living, which includes below-national average costs for housing and transportation. Community pride is evident in the private and city funds invested in making Marshfield a great place to live. Located one mile outside of town, you will have access to 6,500 acres for hiking, biking, hunting, canoeing, cross-country skiing, berry picking, and wildlife or bird watching or simply enjoying the fresh air. With excellent schools and high school graduation rates high above the national average, Marshfield is committed to offering and preparing students for top-notch educational opportunities. Those of us that have chosen to call Marshfield home have come to enjoy the benefits of short commutes, safe and friendly neighborhoods, fresh air and water, bountiful nature, and so much more. Come and see for yourself. Fun Fact: Marshfield is known as the HEART of Wisconsin!

Job Description

Radiology Core Privileges include the ability to perform history and physical examination, consult, evaluate, diagnose, and provide treatment plans for patients of all ages.

Qualifications

M.D. or D.O. degree.

Experience can be demonstrated in one of the following ways:An applicant who has just completed a residency shall provide his/her residency.ORAn applicant who is not applying directly out of a residency shall provide a quality profile from hospital(s) where he/she currently has privileges showing his/her clinical activity for the past 24 months, including numbers of procedures performed morbidity, mortality, infection rates, and other complications. The applicant must be able to demonstrate active involvement of at least200 Radiology examinations in the last 24 months.ORIf a quality profile is not available from the hospital(s) where the applicant currently has privileges, documentation of the applicant’s clinical activity for the past 24 months will be accepted. The applicant must be able to demonstrate active involvement of at least 200 Radiology examinations in the last 24 months.More education and experience may be required the more advanced the practice becomes.

Successful completion of a hospital affiliated Radiology residency program accredited by the ACGME, the American Osteopathic Association (AOA) or the Royal College of Physician and Surgeons of Canada. The Credentials Committee; Physician Executive orMedical Affairs Committee; and the Board of Directors or the Board of Governors may consider training at residency program accredited by organizations other than the above.Certification by the appropriate specialty board of the American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS), the American Osteopathic Association (AOA), or the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada, as applicable. Those applicants who are notboard certified at the time of application but who have completed their residency training within the last five years shall be eligible, however must achieve board certification within five years from the date of completion of their residency training unless the appropriate governing Board waives such requirement. (Refer to each entities policy for grandfather exceptions)Privileging documents and related credentialing requirements will supersede this job description in defining minimum qualifications, criteria, and scope of practice, if variation between documents exists.

Compensation

Annual compensation of $414,000 if you complete required number of shifts for 1.0 FTE
In addition, a $200,000 retention incentive to be paid if you remain a 1.0 FTE for 4 years (this will be subject to a contractual agreement specifying all details)

Sanford Health offers a nationally competitive compensation plan with an additional physician benefits package including a health, dental and vision insurance, 401K plan, short-term and long-term disability, life insurance, CME allowance, allowed time away, malpractice insurance and tail coverage, and a relocation allowance.

Sanford Health – Marshfield Clinic is a non-profit 501(c)(3) organization. This may qualify you for additional state and/or federal education loan forgiveness programs.

Delivery Consultant

Help organisations unlock their potential through exceptional learning experiences

If you're passionate about creating learning experiences that genuinely make a difference, this could be the role for you.

As a Delivery Consultant, you'll work directly with customers to deliver exceptional learning experiences that help organisations achieve their strategic objectives, build lasting capability, and realise measurable value from their investment in Insights.

Every workshop, coaching conversation and customer interaction is an opportunity to create impact and add value. You'll build trusted relationships with practitioners and senior leaders, strengthen confidence in the Insights portfolio, and help customers turn learning into meaningful action.

This is a customer-facing delivery role first and foremost, allowing you to do what you do best: facilitate engaging learning experiences, inspire change, and help customers achieve measurable outcomes. Alongside delivery, you'll contribute to the ongoing evolution of our learning ecosystem by sharing insights, capturing feedback and helping shape future learning experiences.

What you'll be doing

Creating meaningful impact for customers

  • Deliver engaging, relevant and impactful learning experiences that create real value for customers, facilitating both virtual and face-to-face sessions with confidence, gravitas and agility.

  • Build credibility and trusted relationships with practitioners and senior leaders

  • Help customers build capability, confidence and long-term success

  • Ensure every engagement leaves customers clear on their next stage of development

Deepening customer value

You'll be naturally curious about your customers, taking time to understand their challenges, ambitions and opportunities.

  • Build trusted relationships that strengthen long-term partnerships

  • Identify opportunities to deepen impact beyond the immediate engagement

  • Help customers understand the full value of the wider Insights portfolio

  • Support practitioner development, confidence and product adoption

  • Capture and qualify opportunities that support future customer growth

  • Develop collaborative partnerships with our sales colleagues, providing feedback and debriefing opportunities following delivery sessions

Shaping the future of learning at Insights

Your experience in the room matters. You'll play a key role in helping us continuously improve how we deliver learning experiences.

  • Deliver with agility and flexibility to ensure sessions deliver against outcomes and objectives

  • Contribute to the improvement of learning materials and facilitation approaches

  • Share practical facilitation insight and best practice with colleagues

  • Capture customer and practitioner feedback, themes and learning observations

  • Identify opportunities to improve future delivery and customer experience

  • Collaborate across the business to strengthen learning experiences and customer outcomes

  • Contribute to communities of practice and shared learning

What you'll bring

  • Customer-focused, with a genuine passion for creating meaningful outcomes

  • Commercially curious, always looking for ways to deepen value and impact

  • Professional and credible, able to build trust at every level

  • Learning-oriented, continually reflecting, improving and sharing insight

  • Collaborative, enjoying working across teams to achieve the best outcomes

  • Confident in front of customers, bringing energy, presence and authenticity to every interaction

What you'll bring

  • Customer-focused, with a genuine passion for creating meaningful outcomes
  • Commercially curious, always looking for ways to deepen value and impact
  • Professional and credible, able to build trust at every level
  • Learning-oriented, continually reflecting, improving and sharing insight
  • Collaborative, enjoying working across teams to achieve the best outcomes
  • Confident in front of customers, bringing energy, presence and authenticity to every interaction
  • Highly experienced in Insights Discovery, holding and maintaining an active certification with a commitment to continuous professional development

What you're great at

  • Delivering high-impact facilitation and learning experiences
  • Building strong relationships with practitioners and senior stakeholders
  • Translating Insights into practical, real-world application
  • Spotting patterns and turning them into meaningful improvements
  • Communicating clearly and influencing effectively
  • Collaborating across teams and functions to drive incredible experiences and value
  • Creating engaging customer experiences that leave a lasting impression

What success looks like

You'll know you're making a difference when:

  • Customers achieve their intended outcomes and realise measurable value
  • Learning experiences generate strong feedback and advocacy
  • Customers leave inspired, confident and clear on what's next
  • Opportunities for further impact and growth are identified
  • Your insights help improve future delivery, resources and learning experiences
  • You contribute to a culture of learning, collaboration and continuous improvement across the business

Why join us?

This is an opportunity to combine your passion for facilitation, coaching and customer impact in a role where your work creates meaningful change every day. You'll help organisations build capability, support practitioners on their development journey, and play an important role in shaping the future of learning at Insights.

If you love creating transformative learning experiences and building relationships that make a lasting difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Everyone is welcome at Insights. We’re dedicated to creating a space where you belong — that means accepting you for who you are now and supporting you on your journey towards whoever you want to become.

Our colourful solutions help people see themselves and others in a new light and we love encouraging our diverse global community to experience the transformational power of Insights Discovery. Through listening and learning, we will continue to foster the connections that matter to build a more inclusive culture.

It is in our nature to nurture. We have developed an organisation which puts care for our people, inclusion, belonging and wellbeing at the heart of our approach. We’re strengthened by a community where we work together to co-create a culture that celebrates difference and welcomes everybody.

We love learning. We want to be better tomorrow than we are today and we’re up for the journey. Unapologetically human, undoubtedly individual. Colourful to our core.

raw.description:
Job Title: Director, Major Gifts

Organizational Unit: Development

Reports To: Chief Development Officer

Supervises: Mid-level Giving & Prospecting Officer

Location: Equality Now is a remote organization. This position may be based in Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Virginia, or Washington, D.C., with a strong preference for candidates based in New York.

MISSION OBJECTIVE:

The Director, Major Gifts plays a pivotal role in advancing Equality Now’s global mission by leading and growing a major gifts portfolio, including gala sponsorships, mid-level giving and donor engagement. In partnership with the Chief Development Officer and Chief Executive Officer, the Director translates Equality Now’s development strategy into actionable fundraising plans, strengthens donor pipelines and systems, and cultivates meaningful relationships with individuals, family foundations, and philanthropic networks.This role spans strategy, donor cultivation and stewardship, portfolio management, events, executive engagement, and team leadership, and collaborates closely with Annual Giving & Development Operations functions. It requires an experienced fundraising leader with sound judgment, strong relationship-management skills, cross-cultural fluency, and the ability to translate Equality Now’s complex legal and programmatic work into compelling opportunities for philanthropic investment.

The Director will have the opportunity to shape and strengthen Equality Now’s Individual and Major Giving program during an important period of organizational growth. The successful candidate must be comfortable building systems, navigating complexity, inspiring donors and colleagues, and building the capacity of supervisee(s) and other junior staff focused on securing sustainable revenue to advance legal and systemic change for women and girls worldwide.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

The following provides a general outline of the role. It is not exhaustive, and responsibilities may evolve at the discretion of the CDO based on organizational needs and priorities.

Purpose: Innovate for Mission Expansion

  • Serve as the senior lead for operationalizing the Individual & Major Giving strategy, translating our 2026-2030 development strategy into actionable plans, systems, and donor pathways across the full Individual Giving portfolio.
  • Drive the execution and refinement of Equality Now’s high-touch major donor growth strategy, including implementing a network-mapping approach, strengthening Advisory Board and Ambassador engagement, building individualized strategies for UHNW, and designing innovative donor/prospect engagement initiatives (eg-salons, donor cohorts, donor journeys, in-kind/volunteer opportunities for mission impact)
  • Partner with the CEO and CDO to support high-value donor/prospect cultivation and shape donor-facing opportunities aligned with organizational priorities, advising on donor motivations, portfolio insights, and potential engagement opportunities.
  • Provide strategic leadership to align all tiers of individual giving—major gifts, gala sponsorships, mid-level, and annual giving—ensuring cohesive messaging, clear donor journeys, and seamless handoffs between donor segments.
  • Lead maintenance and continuous improvement of pipeline development and tracking practices, including
    donor qualification, engagement strategies, moves management, and standardized systems that enhance efficiency, clarity, and visibility across the portfolio.
  • Lead/guide the development of donor-facing cases for support, investment opportunities, and strategic offerings, ensuring they reflect Equality Now’s mission, program vision, and funder-aligned messaging.

Engagement: Advocate

  • Manage a portfolio of high-value donors and prospects, cultivating deep, trust-based relationships with individuals and family foundations capable of $10,000–$250,000+ giving, while identifying opportunities and supporting leadership-level engagement.
  • Support CEO and CDO engagement with top-tier donors and prospects, preparing strategic briefings, donor intelligence, outreach recommendations, follow-up plans, and bespoke cultivation opportunities.
  • Oversee and elevate the mid-level donor program, ensuring a compelling donor journey that supports upgrades and helps to surface and convert major donor prospects.
  • Engage and activate Advisory Board members and other supporters and ambassadors, partnering with them to leverage networks, cultivate prospective donors, support events, and build community around Equality Now.
  • Serve as an external ambassador for Equality Now, representing the mission with fluency in global women’s rights and human rights–cultivating relationships and expanding networks in philanthropic and peer spaces.
  • Ensure donor experiences reflect mission-driven, community-centered engagement, including opportunities to meet international staff, join learning conversations, attend cultivation events, and participate in curated donor experiences.
  • Strengthen departmental and cross-departmental collaboration, to ensure donor messaging is programmatically accurate, compelling, and aligned with organizational impact narratives, and that the development program gains efficiencies and effectiveness through collaboration across corporate, institutional and individual giving.

Delivery: Define Project Cycle

  • Lead the operational management of the entire Major & Mid-levelGiving portfolio, overseeing processes, timelines, deliverables, and performance standards across major gifts, gala sponsorships, mid-level giving, and annual giving.
  • Implement and oversee strong systems for donor/prospect planning and tracking, including moves management, portfolio assignment, forecasting, and performance analytics, ensuring leadership always has clear visibility into pipeline health.
  • Partner with the Manager, Annual Fund & Development Operations, to ensure excellence in development operations, data integrity, analytics, and annual fund growth strategies.
  • Contribute to the planning and execution of high-impact donor events with Comms & Development colleagues, including the gala, cultivation salons, and community-building convenings, ensuring events advance the 2026-2030 development strategy and build momentum for donor/prospect engagement and pipeline development.
  • Develop individualized donor strategies and annual engagement plans, ensuring they are tailored to the donors’ interests, mission-centered, and coordinated with leadership involvement and organizational priorities and opportunities.
  • Produce high-quality donor communications and materials, partnering with Programs and Communications to prepare proposals, impact updates, donor briefings and reports, strategic correspondence, and leadership-level messaging.
  • Ensure accurate reporting, analytics, and revenue projections, synthesizing donor engagement metrics, portfolio movement, and pipeline health to support leadership decision-making and organizational planning.
  • Drive continuous learning and adaptive planning, integrating donor insights, event performance, campaign outcomes, and Strategic Plan benchmarks into ongoing improvements to Major Giving and Mid-level gift operations.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

This position supervises staff and is responsible for providing leadership, guidance, development, and performance management. Responsibilities may evolve based on organizational needs.

Leadership and Team Management

  • Provide clear direction, priorities, and performance expectations to direct reports.
  • Hold regular check-ins, monitor performance, provide timely feedback, and support professional growth.
  • Foster an inclusive, accountable, transparent, and high-performing team culture.
  • Address operational and personnel issues promptly, fairly, and in coordination with People & Culture when appropriate.

Performance and Development

  • Conduct performance reviews and identify individual and team development needs.
  • Coach and mentor staff to strengthen fundraising, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
  • Promote cross-functional learning and knowledge sharing.

Operations and Workflow

  • Manage workflows, priorities, workloads, leave, and coverage to maintain operational continuity.
  • Monitor progress, quality, and outcomes against agreed objectives.
  • Hold regular team meetings to communicate priorities, share updates, and address challenges.

Compliance and Collaboration

  • Ensure adherence to organizational policies, ethical standards, safeguarding requirements, and applicable laws.
  • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration across departments and leadership.
  • Model Equality Now’s values of integrity and accountability, inclusiveness, resilience, and empathy.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS & TARGET SKILLS PROFILE:
The Director will be thoroughly committed to Equality Now’s mission. The position requires deep subject-matter expertise, visionary leadership, and functional integration capacity. Specific requirements include:

Substantive Knowledge

  • Deep expertise in major gift fundraising, high-touch donor engagement strategies, and best practice moves management, ideally in a global nonprofit setting, with demonstrated success in securing 5–7 figure gifts from individuals and family foundations
  • Strong understanding or direct experience in event fundraising, high-touch donor engagement and strengthening development operations and workflows.
  • Familiarity with global human rights, women’s rights and gender equality funding landscapes (highly desirable). Understanding of legal, advocacy and movement building approaches is a plus.
  • Proven ability to manage, mentor and develop staff.


Communication Skills

  • Fluent in English; proficiency in Spanish, French, or Arabic is a plus.
  • Adept at fostering cross-cultural collaboration and cultivating trust-based relationships consistent with the mission and values of Equality Now.
  • Exceptional donor relationship management and communication skills, with a demonstrated aptitude for translating complex legal, financial, and programmatic concepts into compelling, polished, audience-specific decks, proposals and cases for support.
  • Strong listening, verbal and interpersonal skills to engage professionally and effectively with HNW donors, senior leadership, partners, and staff across geographies and cultures.
  • Adept at facilitating cross-functional collaboration, ensuring clarity, transparency, and strategic alignment between Development, Programs, and Finance, while fostering trust, accountability, and mutual respect across diverse and dispersed teams.


Execution Skills

  • Demonstrated leadership experience, with a focus on strategic delivery and operational excellence.
  • Proven ability to recruit, mentor, and manage staff, fellows, and consultants, fostering high-performing, accountable teams, while modeling inclusive leadership, ensuring all voices are heard, valued, and meaningfully integrated into decision-making processes.
  • Strategic and creative thinker with a record of translating vision into measurable outcomes.
  • Strong project management skills with a track record of meeting deadlines and producing high-quality deliverables in fast-paced environments.
  • Highly organized, results-oriented, and adaptable, with experience in database management (Raiser’s Edge NXT or equivalent).
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally and domestically, sometimes on short notice, to support regional teams, engage with partners, and represent Equality Now.

Targeted Specialized Knowledge

  • Bachelor's degree required, Master’s degree, Continuing Education or significant professional experience in relevant fields is highly desired (e.g., International Relations, Nonprofit Management, Public Policy, Law, Human Rights, CFRE certification, etc)
  • 10+ years of progressively responsible fundraising experience, including substantial, independent donor-facing work and staff/program management responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated success working in a global human rights, gender equality, or related international NGO context, with proven ability to navigate diverse and complex organizations is preferred.

COMPENSATION:

At Equality Now, our compensation philosophy reflects our commitment to advancing the human rights of women and girls through lasting legal and systemic change. We approach pay holistically, recognizing base salary as one part of a broader total rewards package designed to support employee wellbeing, growth, and long-term engagement.

  • Base Salary Range: $120,000–$140,000 USD

The final offer will be determined based on several factors, including geographic location, relevant experience, demonstrated skills, qualifications, and internal equity. Equality Now also provides a comprehensive total rewards package, including health and retirement benefits, generous leave, and professional development opportunities.

HOW TO APPLY:

Applicants must submit a resume or CV and a cover letter. Incomplete applications will not be considered. The application period will close at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on October 14, 2026. Due to the anticipated volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

Equality Now is strong because it is diverse. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Equality Now is an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you’re hungry to grow, eager to tackle new challenges and ready to drive real impact in a rapidly expanding environment, then welcome to THRIVE!

Position Overview:

Thrive is looking for a ServiceNow Developer to build and maintain the integrations and automation behind our managed services platform. You'll connect ServiceNow to the partner, RMM and data systems we depend on, automate manual workflows, and write SQL against Snowflake to move and check the data behind our reporting and our Client Portal. You'll work closely with product, DevOps and service delivery teams. The work runs from design through production support.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build and maintain two-way integrations between ServiceNow and outside systems using REST and SOAP APIs, Scripted REST APIs and MID Server where needed.
  • Write and maintain server-side logic: Business Rules, Script Includes, Scheduled Jobs, Transform Maps and Import Sets.
  • Build automation with Flow Designer, subflows, actions and Workflow to cut manual work in ITSM and service delivery.
  • Write, tune and troubleshoot SQL queries in Snowflake to extract, transform, reconcile and check data flowing into and out of ServiceNow.
  • Build and support data pipelines between Snowflake and ServiceNow, such as device, asset or ticket data synchronization and deduplication.
  • Put ACLs, roles and data security controls in place, following least-privilege principles.
  • Troubleshoot integration failures, sync gaps and performance problems in production, and find the root cause.
  • Take part in code reviews, manage update sets and follow release processes from development through test to production.
  • Document integration designs, data mappings, runbooks and technical decisions.
  • Work with stakeholders to turn business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience.
  • Strong JavaScript skills, including ServiceNow's server-side scripting environment (GlideRecord, GlideAjax, GlideSystem and ES5 constraints).
  • Proven experience building ServiceNow integrations with REST APIs, including authentication (OAuth 2.0, Basic, API keys), JSON parsing and error handling.
  • Working SQL knowledge: joins, aggregations, CTEs, filtering and basic query optimization.
  • Experience with Flow Designer and ServiceNow automation tools.
  • Understanding of the ServiceNow data model, ACLs and role-based security.
  • Familiarity with update sets, instance cloning and multi-instance development lifecycles.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and comfort working through problems that span more than one system.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred:

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake: querying, views, stages, or tasks and streams.
  • Experience in an MSP or IT services environment, or with RMM/PSA tools such as NinjaOne or ConnectWise.
  • Familiarity with CMDB, IRE (Identification and Reconciliation Engine) or data deduplication strategies.
  • Exposure to ServiceNow ITSM, CSM or Service Portal development.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines or Azure DevOps.
  • Some background in Python or other scripting languages for data work.
  • ServiceNow certifications: Certified System Administrator (CSA) and Certified Application Developer (CAD) preferred; Implementation Specialist is a plus.

  • Executive Presence: Strong commercial acumen with the confidence to influence and challenge senior decision-makers through consultative conversations.
  • AI & Sales Technology: Comfortable leveraging AI-powered sales tools, CRM platforms, sales engagement technologies and intent data to improve prospecting, research and pipeline management.

Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

About the Role:

At Cresta, shipping AI is only half the story. Deploying it successfully is where the real impact happens.

As an AI Deployment Manager, you’ll own the moment where cutting-edge AI becomes real-world results. You’ll lead customer deployments end-to-end, turning ambitious AI initiatives into live, adopted solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.

This role is perfect for someone who loves leading complex projects, working directly with customers, and seeing technology make a tangible difference. You’ll be hands-on, customer-facing, and deeply embedded in how Cresta delivers value at scale.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Customers launch AI solutions that actually get used—and drive real business outcomes
  • Deployments run smoothly, on time, and against clearly defined success metrics
  • Customers leave deployment confident, excited, and ready to scale
  • Internal teams rely on you to bring clarity, structure, and momentum to complex initiatives
  • You consistently turn complexity into forward progress

Qualifications We Value:

  • Experience leading technical or AI-driven SaaS implementations
  • Strong project management skills paired with a consultative, customer-first mindset
  • Comfort working with technical concepts, data, and analytics
  • Ability to translate complex technology into clear, actionable plans
  • Bias toward execution, outcomes, and ownership
  • Thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments

Why You’ll Love This Role:

  • You’ll own some of the most visible and impactful work at Cresta
  • You’ll work hands-on with cutting-edge AI used by leading enterprises
  • You’ll partner deeply with customers and see the impact of your work firsthand
  • You’ll collaborate with world-class teams across product, engineering, and GTM
  • You’ll help define what “great AI deployment” looks like at scale

Perks & Benefits:

  • Medical, dental, and vision plans designed to support you and your family
  • Paid parental leave
  • Monthly Health & Wellness allowance
  • Work-from-home office stipend
  • Lunch reimbursement for in-office employees

Compensation at Cresta:

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

The posted base salary range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

Salary Range: $120,000 - $175,000 + Bonus + Equity

About the Role

Our Call Center and Clinical teams go above and beyond for our patients and partners by combining the friendliness of your neighborhood pharmacy with the speed of a fast-moving startup. We believe in changing the traditional pharmacy model for the better to provide a five-star experience.

The Care Supervisor, Programs will lead key initiatives and programs aimed at positioning the pharmacy as an industry leader in patient experience, clinical services and overall care. This role includes cultivating and sustaining robust relationships with external partners, resolving intricate cases, and overseeing agents in pharmacy operations. The Care Supervisor, Programs will also serve as a point of contact for escalated issues from patients, providers, or partners and deliver exceptional customer service via phone, text, chat, and email. Further responsibilities include ensuring streamlined, compliant, and superior operations and propelling continuous improvement initiatives alongside stakeholders. The ideal candidate will possess a strong clinical background to support Specialty and Specialty-Lite programs, as well as manufacturer partnerships, exemplary leadership skills, and a dedication to enhancing patient care.

This role requires strong ownership and accountability for team execution and performance outcomes. The ideal candidate excels in project management, driving program roadmaps, tracking milestones, and measuring success. They are skilled at aligning cross-functional teams and managing stakeholders to meet objectives.

Effective communication, data-driven decision-making, and pharmacy systems proficiency are key. A solid understanding of regulatory compliance, along with the ability to identify risks and implement mitigation strategies, is essential for successful program delivery.



Accelerate Your Career as You

  • Operational Oversight: Supervise daily execution of pharmacy programs, including new workflow and performance management, staff scheduling, and defect tracking, and reconciliation.   • Compliance: Ensure adherence to all local, state, and federal regulations, as well as company policies and procedures.
  • Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of pharmacists and/or technicians, fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment.

  • 2+ years of experience in a supervisory or leadership role
  • Education: Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) degree from an accredited school of pharmacy.

Description

Personetics is the financial intelligence layer for banks. Our Cognitive Banking platform turns a bank's own transaction data into real-time, personalised guidance, delivered in the bank's own channels and under its own brand. It embeds into the systems a bank already runs, extending what those investments deliver rather than replacing them.

More than 100 financial institutions use Personetics to reach over 150 million customers across 30 markets. We work from New York, London, Singapore, São Paulo and Tel Aviv.

About the position

You will work at the forefront of how AI is changing retail banking, alongside the Tier 1 and Tier 2 institutions across ASEAN and North Asia, at the level where digital and data strategy is actually set: Chief Digital Officers, Chief Data & AI Officers and Heads of Retail. Some are already our customers. Others are deciding now how to build the intelligence layer between their data and their customers, and your job is to earn the right to shape that decision.

You will be working from a position of strength. Banks already have the data, the products, the rails and the customer's trust. What they do not have is a way to turn all of it into guidance that arrives at the right moment, at scale, and within the rules. That gap is costing them: 80 percent of consumers in Asia Pacific would consider switching banks to close it. You are here to make sure they close it with us.

Responsibilities

  • Win new Tier 1 and Tier 2 banks. Develop and execute account strategies across the region, building senior relationships and getting into banks early, before a formal process begins. Arrive with a considered point of view on a bank's position and priorities.
  • Own the commercial relationship in the accounts we already serve, extending into new business lines, new markets and new use cases, and ensuring long-term partnerships continue to earn their place.
  • Manage the full cycle from sourcing through to signature, including senior stakeholder engagement, technical and security evaluation, regulatory and outsourcing review, procurement and legal. Build the commercial case on the bank’s own economics and defend it with confidence.
  • Direct pre-sales, and the professional services architects who come in behind them, along with product and customer success, into the accounts where they will change the outcome. Lead a coordinated pursuit rather than a solo one.
  • Maintain accurate qualification, pipeline and forecasting, and give the business a clear and honest view of what is real.
  • Represent Personetics at the industry events and client forums that matter across the region, and turn that presence into relationships and pipeline.

Requirements

  • A track record of sourcing and closing complex enterprise software deals with banks or large financial institutions, as the accountable owner of the full sales cycle
  • Credibility with senior banking stakeholders, and the instinct to earn a strategic conversation rather than a product one
  • Experience selling into environments where an incumbent platform or an in-house build already exists
  • The ability to build a commercial business case and defend it with a finance stakeholder
  • The judgement to tell a bank something it did not want to hear, and the standing to be listened to when you do
  • The patience for cycles measured in quarters, and the discipline to keep one moving through the months when nothing visible is happening
  • Based in Singapore or Hong Kong
  • Willing to travel across the region, approximately 30% to 40%

What You Can Expect From Us

  • An established customer base in the region to build from, with 25 million active users across Asia Pacific
  • Referenceable customers in the region who will take a call from a prospect
  • Dedicated pre-sales for the region, working with you from first meeting through to solution design, with professional services architects joining for technical depth as deals progress
  • Regional marketing and an active presence at the industry events that matter across ASEAN
  • A leadership team that works alongside you in your accounts
  • Remote-first, with an office in Singapore and colleagues to share it with when you want to. No required days.

Senior Data Scientist, People Analytics


We are Lennar

Lennar is one of the nation's leading homebuilders, dedicated to making an impact and creating an extraordinary experience for their Homeowners, Communities, and Associates by building quality homes and providing exceptional customer service, giving back to the communities in which we work and live in, and fostering a culture of opportunity and growth for our Associates throughout their career. Lennar has been recognized as a Fortune 500® company and consistently ranked among the top homebuilders in the United States.


A Career that Empowers You to Build Your Future

As a Senior Data Scientist on Lennar's People Analytics team, you'll build the models that anticipate what's ahead for our workforce: attrition and turnover risk, hiring and headcount needs, and the trends underneath them. You'll also build the AI agents that deliver that work directly to HR leaders, so forecasts reach the point of decision rather than sitting in a report. This is a newly created position and the first dedicated data science role on the People Analytics team. You'll have significant latitude in shaping how the work gets done, from the modeling approaches we adopt to the standards we hold for validation and how results are presented to senior leadership. You'll work closely with HR COEs and hands-on with Workday and other people systems, plus the metrics Visier surfaces on top of them. You'll report to the Head of People Analytics.



Your Responsibilities on the Team

  • Partner directly with HR leaders to understand what they need forecasted or automated and build models and agents they trust enough to act on.
  • Build and deploy predictive models in Python and SQL. Monitor model performance over time, retesting as new data arrives and refining when accuracy drifts, so predictions and recommendations stay reliable.
  • Build AI agents that can query People data, reason over it, and take action, along with the tool use, orchestration, and guardrails that let them work safely with sensitive workforce data.
  • Select the method that fits the question, apply experimentation and causal inference where the question is about cause, quantify uncertainty, and be prepared to explain the approach to senior leadership.
  • Use LLMs to surface patterns in unstructured People data such as survey comments and exit interview notes and incorporate what you find into your models.
  • Develop deep familiarity with Lennar's people data, extracting and structuring what your models require, identifying gaps that would sharpen the output, and partnering with Data Engineering on the pipelines behind it.
  • Explain statistical concepts, model results, and agent behavior to HR and business audiences without a quantitative background.
  • Handle sensitive workforce and compensation data with discretion.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Statistics, Economics, Math, Computer Science, or a related analytical field with equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience (1+ with PhD, 3+ with MS) as a data scientist producing models and engineering solutions in a production environment.
  • Depth in predictive modeling, including regression, time series forecasting, and classification.
  • A strong statistical foundation, including experimentation and causal inference, and the judgment to select the right method for the question at hand.
  • Proven ability to work independently, including designing your own validation approach and articulating your methodology to technical and non-technical reviewers.
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs, whether agents, tool use and function calling, retrieval, or prompt-driven workflows, and using tools such as Claude to accelerate your own development. We're interested in what you've built and how you evaluated it, more than years of experience in a field this new.
  • Experience with large, complex operational or HR datasets, including cleaning and structuring messy data and extracting it yourself through SQL or APIs.
  • Fluency in SQL and strong proficiency in Python.
  • Ability to explain model results and agent behavior in plain language to non-technical HR and business leaders.

Physical & Office/Site Presence Requirements:

This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the incumbent to have the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary.

About Builders FirstSource

Builders FirstSource is a leading U.S. supplier of structural building products, value-added components, and services to the professional market. Through technology modernization, business transformation, and digital innovation, BFS is reimagining how materials are manufactured, moved, sold, and delivered across North America.

As part of this transformation, BFS is implementing SAP S/4HANA and modern digital capabilities to create standardized, scalable, and integrated business processes across our enterprise.

Supporting hundreds of manufacturing, distribution, and operational locations, our technology teams partner closely with the business to modernize critical capabilities spanning planning, production, procurement, warehousing, transportation, sales, delivery, and corporate functions.

Application Services plays a key role in this journey by delivering and supporting the systems, integrations, data, and digital capabilities that enable our business to operate efficiently and scale for future growth.

das gibt es zu tun

  • Du steuerst anspruchsvolle digitale Umsetzungsprojekte und hältst Scope, Budget, Qualität und Timing sicher auf Kurs.

das bringst du mit

das bieten wir dir

werde teil des teams

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, remote oder im Office.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.

We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented Video Editor and Motion Graphics Designer who can transform ideas, recordings, and raw footage into polished content that captures attention, strengthens our brands, and grows our online audience.

This is more than a traditional editing position. We need someone who understands storytelling, design, writing, artificial intelligence, content strategy, social media publishing, and audience growth.

What You’ll Do

  • Edit long-form and short-form videos, including podcasts, interviews, educational videos, advertisements, webinars, and social media content.
  • Create motion graphics, animated text, branded transitions, visual effects, and other engaging design elements.
  • Turn long-form recordings into high-performing short-form content for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, and other platforms.
  • Optimize content for each platform, including its dimensions, length, pacing, hook, captions, hashtags, keywords, thumbnails, and calls to action.
  • Develop and execute strategies to increase followers, engagement, reach, watch time, and brand awareness.
  • Research audience interests, competitors, platform trends, keywords, and content opportunities.
  • Build, manage, and maintain organized content calendars across multiple brands and social platforms.
  • Upload, schedule, and publish content using native platform tools and third-party social media management platforms.
  • Confirm that scheduled posts are formatted correctly, published on time, and properly tagged and linked.
  • Engage with followers by monitoring and responding appropriately to comments and messages.
  • Track performance and use data to identify which topics, formats, hooks, and publishing times produce the best results.
  • Test new content ideas and make recommendations based on audience response and platform analytics.
  • Coordinate content around campaigns, company priorities, events, and important dates.
  • Use AI-powered tools to improve editing speed, content quality, repurposing, transcription, writing, research, and workflow efficiency.
  • Write and improve video hooks, headlines, captions, descriptions, scripts, hashtags, and calls to action.
  • Create thumbnails, social graphics, presentation visuals, and other branded marketing assets.
  • Review all work carefully for spelling, grammar, visual consistency, brand accuracy, and technical quality.
  • Collaborate with marketing, creative, and leadership teams to turn ideas into compelling content.

Portfolio Requirement

Please include a portfolio demonstrating:

  • Short-form social videos
  • Long-form video editing
  • Motion graphics or After Effects work
  • Graphic design, social graphics, and thumbnails
  • Content adapted for different platforms
  • Social media accounts or content calendars you have managed
  • Examples showing follower, engagement, or reach growth
  • Before-and-after examples, if available

When applying, please explain which AI, content-calendar, and social media scheduling tools you currently use. Please also share a specific example of an account you helped grow, including your strategy and measurable results.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this position means consistently producing professional, on-brand content that is visually engaging, clearly written, optimized for its intended platform, scheduled accurately, and published on time.

The right person will also help grow our audience by increasing followers, engagement, reach, watch time, and meaningful interactions—not by focusing only on content volume.

Requirements

Tools and Skills

The ideal candidate should have experience with:

  • Adobe Premiere Pro
  • Capcut
  • Adobe After Effects
  • Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator
  • Descript
  • Tella
  • Canva or similar design platforms
  • Social media scheduling and content-calendar tools
  • Native publishing tools for LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube
  • Social media analytics and reporting tools
  • AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar creative tools
  • Captioning, transcription, audio cleanup, and content-repurposing tools
  • Social media growth strategies and platform best practices

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong video-editing and motion-graphics skills
  • Experience building, managing, and executing content calendars
  • A demonstrated ability to build social media accounts and grow followers organically
  • An understanding of audience development, community engagement, and content distribution
  • The ability to schedule, publish, and quality-check social media content
  • The ability to interpret analytics and turn performance data into better content
  • A strong eye for design, composition, pacing, typography, and visual detail
  • A clear understanding of branding and visual consistency
  • Strong writing, proofreading, and storytelling abilities
  • Knowledge of how audiences consume content differently across social platforms
  • The ability to take ownership of a project from the initial idea through publication and performance analysis
  • Curiosity about AI and a willingness to test new tools and improve workflows
  • Excellent organization, communication, and time-management skills
  • Dependability, creativity, and close attention to detail
  • Must be Able to talk to clients and execute Virtual Interviews.

Benefits

  • Fully remote position with flexible working hours.
  • Opportunity to work with a dynamic, growth-driven team

OneIMS is a global inbound digital marketing agency with offices in sunny Southwest Florida and regional offices throughout the world. Our team is dedicated to helping our clients achieve their sales and marketing goals using the most up-to-date and innovative strategies and technologies available. We believe we are one of the best in the industry and are looking for candidates who are just as passionate about marketing as we are.
At OneIMS you will enjoy a great working environment, plenty of perks, nurturing leadership team, and caring co-workers. Come work with us if you believe you can make our team even better!
