raw.title: Principal Product Manager, Identity & Trust
raw.excerpt: About Life360Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love.
raw.description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit .

Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

The Services/Identity team in Foundations owns the systems that decide who our members are and whether they can get in: account creation, sign-in, session management, and recovery for families across more than 180 countries. You'll work hand in hand with Security, Engineering, Data, Customer Care, Legal/Privacy, and our Growth/Onboarding teams to ensure members can access Life360 easily and worry free while protecting those systems from an increasingly sophisticated threat landscape.

About the Job

Every Life360 moment starts with a sign-in. A parent opens the app to check on a teen's first drive. A grown child makes sure their aging parent arrives home safely. A family shares their live location to coordinate with neighbors on a trip. If the wrong person gets into an account, or a loved one gets locked out, we've created a trust-breaking moment. Identity is the front door to our members' most sensitive data, and it has to be effortless and secure. We are looking for a seasoned product leader with a strong point of view on how to make that true at global scale.

In this role, you'll own and execute the strategy for how Life360 determines who our members are and keeps them safe: identity, authentication, account sign-in, and account recovery. You'll own the problem end to end, from the sign-in experiences members see to the identity services, risk signals, and data models behind them. You'll set the bar for what a world-class consumer identity experience looks like, define the metrics that prove it, and drive alignment across engineering, security, privacy, customer care, and leadership. This isn't a support role. You're a force multiplier for every team that depends on identity, working directly with Foundations and Enterprise leadership to build the practices, systems, and knowledge that keep our members' accounts safe.

The US-based salary range for this position is $178,500 to $261,500. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the front door. Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for AuthN and AuthZ at Life360, along with the systems that power registration, member access, session management, credential lifecycle, and CIAM integration, across mobile, web, partner integrations, and agentic connectors, spanning both the member experience and the services behind it.
  • Make recovery safe and humane. Design account management and recovery that gets legitimate members back in quickly, without handing keys to an attacker. Balance friction against trust, and treat recovery as a security surface, not just a customer support flow.
  • Stay ahead of attackers. Partner with Security on Enterprise Tech to anticipate account takeover, credential stuffing, phishing, SIM-swap, and social engineering of our support channels, and build layered defenses before they show up in the data.
  • Move beyond passwords. Lead our roadmap for passkeys, passwordless and phishing-resistant authentication, step-up and risk-based authentication, and device-bound sessions, and drive adoption without breaking the experience for members on older devices or in lower-connectivity markets.
  • Build for the whole world. Design identity for 180+ countries: phone-number-first behaviors, SMS and OTP deliverability and cost, regional carrier and device realities, localization, and regional regulatory requirements.
  • Earn trust with families. Handle the identity questions unique to a family product: teen and minor accounts, age assurance, parental consent, circle membership, and who is allowed to see what, in line with privacy and compliance obligations such as COPPA and GDPR.
  • Set the standard. Define company-wide identity and trust KPIs (account takeover rate, sign-in success, recovery success, time to recover, false positive rate, support contacts per account issue, passkey adoption) that let product and engineering move fast without second-guessing the foundation.
  • Make the invisible visible. Drive the telemetry, fraud signals, and detection approach so teams can see abuse, friction, and drop-off across the entire identity journey.
  • Translate security into decisions. Turn threat models, incident learnings, and identity data into sharp narratives for executives: where we're exposed, what it costs us, and where to place the bets now.
  • Unify the ecosystem. Partner with teams across the company, including growth, subscriptions, partnerships, and Customer Care, so identity decisions serve every product and integration that depends on them.

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of product management experience, including significant time at a principal or staff level with cross-functional scope
  • Deep, hands-on experience owning consumer identity, authentication, account security, or trust products at scale, ideally for a global consumer app with tens or hundreds of millions of users
  • Strong cybersecurity depth: you can talk fluently about threat modeling, account takeover, fraud and abuse, MFA, passkeys/FIDO2/WebAuthn, OAuth/OIDC, session management, and credential security, and you hold your own with security engineers and the CISO's team
  • Real empathy for members: you know that a locked-out parent or a worried teenager is on the other end of every flow you design
  • Full-stack product ownership: comfort with backend identity services and APIs, and equal care for the mobile and web experience, including login, onboarding, and recovery UX
  • Global mindset: experience launching and operating identity flows across many countries, regulatory regimes, languages, and device and carrier environments
  • Working knowledge of privacy, compliance, and standards that shape identity (e.g., NIST 800-63, GDPR, CCPA, COPPA); experience with minors' accounts or age assurance is a plus
  • Experience driving alignment across large, matrixed organizations, including Engineering, Security, Legal, Privacy, and Customer Support
  • Strong analytical instincts; you use quantitative data and qualitative signal to define what good looks like, run experiments, and hold the bar there
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; you distill complex security and technical realities into clear business priorities for diverse audiences
  • High ownership and bias for action; you identify the problem and mobilize the right people rather than waiting to be asked

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for employees)
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns
  • Learning & Development programs
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful.Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!

raw.description:
US Payroll and Tax Lead

About Rise

Rise is a global payroll and workforce platform. We help companies hire, pay, and manage employees and contractors anywhere in the world, through our own technology. We're in an active growth phase, launching new products and expanding into new markets, and we're looking for people who want to build alongside us.

The Role

You'll own the full US payroll and tax function: processing, filings, remittances, agency registrations, and year-end reporting across our own employees and the employers we service through our payroll platform.

There's no existing playbook to follow here. You'll be building the processes and controls from scratch, which is exactly the point. We're looking for someone who sees that as the interesting part of the job, not the downside.

You'll also be our closest internal user of the Rise platform itself. When something doesn't work the way it should for US payroll or tax, you'll be the one who spots it first and works directly with our product and engineering teams to get it fixed. Your day-to-day experience will have a real influence on what we build.

What You'll Be Doing

Payroll processing

  • Run end-to-end payroll cycles for our US employee population and the client employers we service, covering wages, deductions, benefits, and garnishments

  • Own the payroll calendar and keep delivery accurate and on time across all pay schedules

  • Handle off-cycle runs and corrections as they come up

Tax filings and compliance

  • Prepare and submit all federal, state, and local payroll tax filings and remittances across all 50 states and DC

  • File all quarterly and annual returns, including W-2s and 1099s, accurately and on time

  • Complete employer registrations and tax account setup in new states and localities as we grow

  • Own the compliance tracker and filing calendar so nothing slips through

  • Manage agency notices and resolve tax discrepancies and audit requests across all active jurisdictions

Client support

  • Be the person our direct payroll customers turn to when they hit a complex compliance question, a tax notice, or an issue they can't figure out on their own

  • Help them get to the right answer quickly

Process and documentation

  • Write the SOPs for payroll processing, filings, reconciliations, and year-end work

  • Build audit-ready records and practical controls into everything we do

Product collaboration

  • Use the Rise platform to do your job and tell us honestly where it falls short

  • Work with product and engineering to turn compliance requirements into features that actually work

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • 6+ years of US payroll experience, with direct ownership of multi-state processing and employment tax compliance

  • Proven, hands-on experience preparing and submitting payroll tax filings and remittances across a wide range of federal, state, and local jurisdictions

  • Experience completing state and local agency registrations

  • Solid working knowledge of multi-state withholding, unemployment tax, W-2 and 1099 requirements, and quarterly and annual return obligations

  • A track record of building processes and controls in environments that weren't fully built out yet

  • Sharp attention to detail and strong reconciliation habits

Strongly preferred

  • Background in a payroll services, EOR, or PEO environment, where you were responsible for payroll and tax on behalf of client employers, not just internal employees

  • Familiarity with payroll tax engines such as MasterTax or Symmetry

  • CPP (Certified Payroll Professional) designation

  • Experience handling tax notices and agency inquiries across multiple jurisdictions

Why Rise

If you want a role where you can see the direct impact of your work, this is it. You'll own a critical function, build it properly from the start, and have a real say in how our product develops. We're a small team doing hard things, and we're looking for people who are genuinely energized by that.

raw.description:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at .

The Opportunity 🚀

Carrot is looking for a Sr. IT Systems Engineer to design, scale, and secure the identity, endpoint, and SaaS platforms that power our global, remote-first workforce. You will set the technical direction for how employees and devices connect to Carrot systems, while staying hands-on in the tooling, automation, and complex problem-solving that make IT reliable at scale.

This role sits at the center of IT engineering. You will lead larger initiatives from design through rollout, partner closely with Information Security on zero-trust and compliance priorities, and raise the bar for the rest of the team through standards, documentation, and mentorship. If you want broad technical ownership, influence over the IT roadmap, and the chance to build systems that grow with a high-growth healthcare company, this role was built for that.

What You’ll Own 💼

In this role, you will:

  • Architect and own Carrot's identity, endpoint, and SaaS platforms, including Okta, JAMF, Intune, and Google Workspace, with a focus on security, reliability, and user experience
  • Lead design and rollout of larger IT initiatives, such as zero-trust access models, device compliance frameworks, and global endpoint standards
  • Build and maintain automation and infrastructure as code that manage configuration, provisioning, and lifecycle workflows at scale
  • Partner with Information Security to design controls, drive vulnerability management, and keep Carrot audit-ready for SOC 2, HIPAA, and customer security reviews
  • Serve as the senior technical escalation point, leading incident response and root cause analysis for complex or high-impact issues
  • Define engineering standards, runbooks, and documentation, and mentor IT teammates to grow their technical depth
  • Evaluate vendors and tools, build business cases, and make clear recommendations on build versus buy tradeoffs
  • Design environments that support global care and operations teams, including secure and efficient remote computing setups
  • Contribute to the IT roadmap and communicate priorities, risks, and progress to technical and business stakeholders

What Success Looks Like 📈

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Established a clear, documented architecture and standards for identity, endpoint, and SaaS management that the team can build on
  • Delivered at least one major platform initiative, such as a zero-trust access model or endpoint modernization, with measurable gains in security posture and employee experience
  • Reduced manual IT work through automation and infrastructure as code, with a measurable drop in recurring ticket volume
  • Strengthened audit readiness, contributing to clean results on security and compliance reviews
  • Raised the technical capability of the team through mentorship, documentation, and shared standards
  • Built trusted partnerships with Information Security, People, Engineering, and Finance

About You ✨

You likely have:

Why This Role Matters 🧡

Every Carrot employee depends on technology that is secure, reliable, and easy to use, whether they are supporting members through deeply personal care journeys or partnering with global employers. This role sets the technical foundation that makes that possible.

As Carrot continues to scale across geographies and functions, the architecture and standards you establish will protect member trust, strengthen our security posture, and give the business the speed and confidence to keep growing.

raw.excerpt: About the RoleAs Finance Analyst, you’ll sit at the center of Daybreak’s finance function, with equal footing in accounting and financial planning.
raw.description:
About the Role

As Finance Analyst, you’ll sit at the center of Daybreak’s finance function, with equal footing in accounting and financial planning. On the accounting side, you’ll own the month-end close process and make sure the numbers leadership, our board, and our investors rely on are accurate, timely, and well supported. On the planning side, you’ll build and maintain the financial models that help us forecast, budget, and decide where to invest. You’ll work directly with the Sr. Director of Finance, who reviews your work and shapes your growth.

Our economics are more interesting than most: revenue comes from school district contracts and insurance reimbursement, and our largest cost is clinician pay. That makes both the accounting and the modeling a real analytical challenge. Getting accruals and revenue recognition right is the foundation, and modeling clinician capacity, utilization, payer mix, and contract economics is how we plan.

You’ll also be a finance partner to the business. Working with leaders across Clinical, Operations, Revenue Cycle, and Go-to-Market, you’ll explain what’s driving revenue and margin and contribute to strategic finance work that shapes how we grow.

This role suits someone who wants both sides of finance: an accountant ready to grow into modeling and FP&A, or an analyst with strong modeling skills and a solid accounting foundation.


What You’ll Do

Build financial models and forecasts

  • Build and maintain Daybreak’s core financial models, including the operating model that links revenue, clinician cost, and margin to the three financial statements
  • Develop driver-based revenue and margin models that capture contract pricing, clinician capacity and utilization, payer mix, and state-level economics
  • Own the annual budget and rolling forecast process in partnership with department leaders and the Sr. Director of Finance
  • Run scenario and sensitivity analyses to show leadership the range of outcomes and what moves them
  • Model new districts, markets, payer contracts, and major investments, with cost-benefit and ROI analysis
  • Support board and investor reporting with accurate, well-documented model outputs
  • Keep models auditable and easy to use: clear structure, documented assumptions, version control, and integrity checks

Own the month-end close

  • Run the close process end to end: maintain the close calendar and checklist, set deadlines with contributors, and deliver on a predictable schedule
  • Prepare journal entries, including accruals, prepaids, deferrals, depreciation and amortization, and recurring and adjusting entries, for review by the Sr. Director of Finance
  • Prepare month-end accruals for clinician compensation, payroll-related costs, and vendor expenses
  • Reconcile bank, credit card, payroll, and clearing accounts, and keep balance sheet reconciliations current and supported
  • Tie subledgers and operational systems (billing and claims data, payroll, expense tools) to the general ledger, and investigate and resolve differences
  • Produce monthly financial statements and a close package, with a clear written explanation of what changed and why
  • Improve the close each month by documenting processes, tightening controls, and automating manual steps

Revenue and receivables accounting

  • Support revenue recognition across district contracts and insurance reimbursement, including contractual adjustments, collectability estimates, and deferred revenue
  • Track AR and AR aging, and reconcile billing-system balances to the GL
  • Partner with Revenue Cycle and Operations to resolve billing, cash application, and payment-posting discrepancies that affect the books

Analysis and business partnering

  • Perform monthly budget-to-actual and variance analysis, highlighting risks and opportunities to plan
  • Partner with department leaders across Clinical, Operations, Revenue Cycle, and Go-to-Market to understand the drivers of revenue, cost, and margin, and turn them into clear recommendations
  • Analyze unit economics, such as cost per session against revenue by state, contract, and payer
  • Build and maintain recurring reports and KPI tracking on revenue, gross margin, and spend
  • Use BI tools and AI-assisted analysis, alongside Excel, to answer questions quickly, and verify numbers against source systems before they reach a decision-maker

Audit, tax, and compliance

  • Prepare schedules and support for annual audits, tax filings, and diligence requests
  • Maintain clear documentation and audit trails
  • Help develop accounting policies and internal controls that scale as we grow

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, or a degree in finance or a related field with substantial accounting coursework. Candidates without an accounting degree should have significant hands-on accounting experience.
  • 2–4 years of accounting or finance experience, including hands-on responsibility for month-end close activities and exposure to budgeting, forecasting, or financial planning
  • Demonstrated financial modeling experience: you’ve built or significantly maintained models such as an operating model, budget, forecast, or driver-based revenue model, and can explain how they work
  • Strong working knowledge of US GAAP and accrual accounting, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and flux analysis
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including lookups, conditional aggregation, and well-structured, auditable models
  • Hands-on experience with a modern GL/accounting system (QuickBooks, NetSuite, or similar)
  • Curiosity about the business and comfort partnering with non-finance stakeholders, with clear written and verbal communication that explains results to non-finance colleagues
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to meet deadlines and manage competing priorities independently in a remote setting

Nice to have

  • CPA or CPA candidacy
  • Experience in FP&A, strategic finance, or business partnering at a startup or high-growth company
  • Experience in healthcare, health tech, revenue cycle or insurance billing, or K-12 contracts
  • Experience with revenue recognition (ASC 606) and AR for variable or third-party payer revenue
  • Experience with planning tools (such as Adaptive) and with dashboarding or BI tools
  • Comfort using AI tools to speed up analysis
  • Experience supporting audits, tax filings, or investor reporting

Compensation and Benefits

  • Salary: $100,000
  • Equity: Strong competitive equity
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage, with Daybreak covering a significant share of premiums for employees and dependents
  • Flexible unlimited time off and company holidays
  • Quarterly mental health days
  • Fully remote work from anywhere in the United States

Du bist im Vertrieb zu Hause und weißt genau, dass Leistung sich lohnen muss?

Dann bist du bei Finanzcheck genau richtig. Wir sind eines der führenden Online-Kreditportale in Deutschland und bringen seit Jahren erfolgreich Kund*innen und Banken zusammen. Dabei setzen wir auf leistungsstarken Vertrieb, moderne Tools und ein Team, das Erfolge feiert.

Bei uns erwartet dich kein Callcenter-Job, sondern eine professionelle Vertriebsumgebung, in der dein Einsatz und dein Ehrgeiz den Unterschied machen. Mit unserer ungedeckelten Provision bestimmst du dein Gehalt selbst – wer stark performt, kann bei uns auch überdurchschnittlich verdienen!

Zur Verstärkung unseres Vertriebsteams mit knapp 100 Vertriebsprofis suchen wir dich ab sofort in Vollzeit als:

Vertriebsprofi - Kreditberatung im Homeoffice (w/m/d)

Das machst du bei uns

  • Du übernimmst die telefonische Kundenberatung und den aktiven Verkauf unserer Kreditlösungen bezüglich der Vermittlung von Krediten unserer Partnerbanken.
  • Vom ersten Kundenkontakt bis zum Vertragsabschluss bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson und führst unsere Kund*innen durch den gesamten Prozess.
  • Mit deinem Gespür für Kund*innenbedürfnisse erstellst du maßgeschneiderte Angebote und überzeugst mit deiner Abschlussstärke.
  • Du setzt moderne Vertriebsmethoden und Tools ein, um deine Abschlüsse effizient und erfolgreich zu gestalten.
  • Dein Fokus liegt klar auf dem Abschluss – die Beratung steht im Vordergrund, aber du verfolgst immer das Ziel, unsere Kreditlösungen zu verkaufen.

Das bist du

  • Du bringst nachweisbare Vertriebserfahrung aus dem Direktvertrieb oder Telesales mit.
  • Idealerweise hast du Produkte oder Dienstleistungen im Bereich Finanzen, Banken und Versicherungen vertrieben bzw. dazu beraten.
  • Begriffe wie Upselling / Cross Selling sind dir nicht fremd – Vertrieb ist für dich mehr als ein Job, es ist dein Antrieb.
  • Am Telefon überzeugst du durch eine klare, professionelle und verbindliche Kommunikation.
  • Du verfügst über Erfahrungen im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen und hast eine gewisse Technikaffinität, um dich schnell in neue Systeme rein zu arbeiten.
  • Du bist ein Teamplayer, aber vor allem ein Hunter, der Spaß daran hat, Kund*innen zu gewinnen und Abschlüsse zu feiern.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Ungedeckelte Provisionen – dein Einsatz bestimmt dein Einkommen, ohne Limit nach oben.
  • Ein Fixgehalt, kombiniert mit einem leistungsstarken Provisionsmodell.
  • Karriere- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten in einem erfolgreichen und wachsenden Vertriebsteam.
  • Work-Life-Balance: Genieße die Flexibilität, zu 100% deutschlandweit im Homeoffice zu arbeiten.
    • Du wohnst in Berlin oder Hamburg? Auch für dich haben wir drei Tage Homeoffice: Mit einem Hybridmodell schaffen wir die perfekte Balance zwischen Fokuszeit und Team-Spirit in unseren modernen Büros vor Ort.

raw.description:
About Ping Identity:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

Reporting to the Sales Director, the Sales Specialist is a field-based position dedicated to driving the adoption of our cutting-edge PingOne Recognize biometric authentication technology. Unlike a traditional generalist role, you will act as a subject matter expert, focusing on net-new logo acquisition and strategic upsells by positioning PingOne Recognize products as the gold standard for passwordless, zero-trust environments. You will leverage a robust internal resource model and global partner directory to displace legacy MFA and revolutionize how enterprises handle digital trust.

You will:

  • Lead the Passwordless Revolution: Create and execute a territory strategy specifically designed to evangelize PingOne Recognize, targeting organizations burdened by legacy MFA and high-friction authentication.
  • Master the Value Prop: Articulate the unique technical and business value of PingOne Recognize—privacy-preserving biometrics, zero-knowledge architecture, and the elimination of credential-based attacks.
  • Engineer Complex Deals: Navigate and close high-stakes contracts by demonstrating how PingOne Recognize integrates into existing CIAM and IAM ecosystems to reduce fraud and improve user experience.
  • Act as a Market Liaison: Provide direct field intelligence to Product and Engineering teams to ensure the PingOne Recognize roadmap remains the industry leader in biometric innovation.
  • Orchestrate Specialist Resources: Work collaboratively with Sales Engineers and Privacy experts to address deep technical inquiries regarding biometric data and compliance.
  • Forecast with Precision: Maintain a high level of transparency in sales activity and pipeline health, specifically tracking the adoption lifecycle of biometric solutions.

You have:

  • Specialized Quota Experience: Significant experience selling high-growth, disruptive enterprise software—ideally within Identity, Biometrics, or Cybersecurity.
  • The "Challenger" Mindset: A proven ability to sign large, strategic projects that require shifting a customer’s mindset from traditional security to modern, biometric-first architectures.
  • C-Level Influence: An established network of CISOs and Digital Transformation leaders who trust your POV on the future of authentication.
  • Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of the drivers of change in the industry, including FIDO standards, GDPR/privacy regulations, and the move toward "Passwordless" enterprise.
  • Strategic Partner Acumen: Experience working with global systems integrators (GSIs) to bake PingOne Recognize into large-scale digital transformation initiatives.
  • Value-Based Methodology: Mastery of value-selling frameworks to move the conversation from "price per seat" to "total risk reduction and UX improvement.
  • Eligibility to work in Italy
  • Fluent Italian language skills

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

  • A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.
  • Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.
  • Regular company and team bonding events.
  • Competitive benefits and perks.
  • Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits:

  • Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule
  • Parental Leave
  • Progressive Healthcare Options
  • Retirement Programs
  • Opportunity for Education Reimbursement
  • Commuter Offset (Specific locations)

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

raw.excerpt: Apollo. io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises.
raw.description:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

The role
You’ll lead detection and response (D&R) strategy for Apollo’s Security team, and you’ll deliver it hands-on. You’ll build detection systems, response automations and investigation tools in weeks, not months. You’ll lead our most complex incidents. You’ll also set the standards and architecture that let the team catch and contain real threats without depending on any one person.

What you’ll do

Strategy and influence

  • Own D&R strategy and turn it into multi-quarter initiatives tied to Security KRs. Report progress and risks to leadership in business terms.
  • Work with Engineering, Infrastructure and IT so logging, telemetry and response readiness are planned into their roadmaps early.
  • Set D&R standards: detections and response as code, review practices, playbook quality, and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Mentor engineers to own detections and lead incidents, and help raise the hiring bar.

Detection engineering and observability

  • Own detection architecture and the multi-quarter coverage plan: log sources, enrichment, correlation, alert routing, and cost at scale.
  • Own security observability: telemetry onboarding, signal quality, threat intel inputs and alert tuning.
  • Run the detection lifecycle: intake and prioritization, unit tests, replay against historical data, attack simulation, and regular reviews of coverage gaps, latency, false positives and MTTD.
  • Stay hands-on: ship MITRE ATT&CK-aligned detections, threat hunts and automations in Panther and Python via Git and CI/CD.

Incident response

  • Own and improve the IR plan: severity model, roles, escalation, communications, on-call and playbooks for our top scenarios.
  • Build IR readiness: tabletop exercises with Engineering, Legal, Fraud and leadership, plus response automation and forensic readiness.
  • Measure IR quality (MTTA/MTTR by severity, repeat incidents, action closure) and feed every incident’s lessons back into detections, automation and process.
  • Lead high-severity incidents as senior technical lead or incident commander across cloud, SaaS and corporate systems.

AI-native by default
You’ll set the standard for AI-augmented D&R. You’ll use AI and agents for triage, enrichment, investigation and response, with guardrails and human-in-the-loop where it matters. You’ll measure the gains in speed, coverage and signal quality. You’ll also help define how we detect misuse of Apollo’s own AI systems and agent features.

Requirements

  • 8+ years in detection and response, detection engineering, security engineering or incident response.
  • Track record of leading D&R strategy or multi-quarter initiatives with measurable results.
  • Hands-on experience designing detection architecture and shipping detection systems on a modern SIEM (Panther highly valued).
  • Strong Python, Git, CI/CD and detection-as-code skills.
  • Experience leading high-severity incidents in cloud and SaaS environments and improving the IR process behind them.
  • Cloud and SaaS expertise, ideally GCP, plus familiarity with tools like Google Workspace, Okta, GitHub, Slack, Atlassian, Cloudflare, CrowdStrike, Kandji and Snowflake.
  • Sound judgment with incomplete information, and the influence to align technical and non-technical leaders without formal authority.

Nice to have

  • Staff, Lead or Principal-level experience at a high-growth cloud or SaaS company.
  • AI-assisted triage, investigation or response in production, with a clear view of its limits.
  • Public security work (detection content, open-source tools, talks, research) or certifications such as GCIA, GCIH or GCED.

How success is measured

  • A D&R strategy tied to Security KRs, with telemetry work committed in other teams’ roadmaps.
  • Better detection coverage and precision for top threats, and a tested IR process with faster MTTD/MTTR and fewer repeat incidents.
  • AI-assisted triage and response in production, with a measurable drop in manual toil.

Tech stack
Panther (SIEM), Python, GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Google Workspace, Okta, GitHub, Slack, Atlassian, Cloudflare, CrowdStrike, Kandji, Snowflake. AI tools: Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Glean.

The listed Pay Range reflects the total cash compensation inclusive of annual base salary and annual bonus as applicable. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonus target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Apollo and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity; company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; at least 10 paid holidays per year, flex PTO, and parental leave; employee assistance program and wellbeing benefits; global travel coverage; life/AD&D/STD/LTD insurance; FSA/HSA and medical, dental, and vision benefits.

Pay Transparency Range
$225,400—$281,800 USD

We are AI Native

Apollo.io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.

Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo

At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we take extreme ownership of our work, move with focus and urgency, and learn voraciously to stay ahead.

We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to own your role and make a real impact. Collaboration is at our core—we’re all for one, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage bold ideas and courageous action, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.

If you’re looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you.

Learn more here!

raw.description:
The Role

Wpromote is seeking a Vice President of Engineering to lead the engineering organization responsible for Polaris, our client CRM and marketing intelligence platform. Polaris supports client and integration management, normalized marketing data, reporting, measurement, forecasting, optimization, anomaly detection, and client insights through internal and client-facing products.

This leader is accountable for engineering strategy, people, architecture, delivery, quality, reliability, security, and financial stewardship. The role sits on the Product Development Leadership team and partners closely with Product, UX, Data Science, Security, Finance, agency leaders, clients, and technology vendors. It requires executive judgment and strong technical depth. The VP must be able to lead through managers and senior engineers while remaining capable of stepping into architecture decisions, critical incidents, and unfamiliar technical problems when the business needs it.

You will scale the engineering organization, its leadership structure, and its development practices as Polaris grows in scope and complexity, as well as continue to push adoption of AI across software development and build the shared platform capabilities, tooling, and infrastructure that allow teams to ship faster while maintaining high standards for quality, reliability, and security.

We offer:
-Unlimited PTO
-Extended Holiday break (Winter)
-100% paid parental leave
-401(k) matching
-Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance
-Sponsored life insurance
-Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance
-Annual Class Pass credits and more!
The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $230,000 - $285,000, based on a variety of factors unique to each candidate, including skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and the respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. At Wpromote, pay ranges are subject to change and are based on specific market medians for similar jobs according to third-party salary benchmark surveys. Individual pay within that range can vary due to skills, experience, and available budget. The total compensation package for this role will include benefits (listed above).
*This position may be performed remotely in most states within the US, with some exclusions
**While this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, we have office hubs in Los Angeles and New York, where you can join in on learning and development opportunities, fun events, take advantage of a space to work, and collaborate in person!
***This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship
Important Notice: Beware of Job Scams
Wpromote recruiting communications will only be sent through our official channels via email addresses. If you see a posting elsewhere that is not reflected on Wpromote.com/careers, it may be a fraudulent posting. We do not require payment or fees during the hiring process nor do we request sensitive information, such as Social Security numbers or payment details. Please safeguard yourself against possible scams and contact us if you encounter any suspicious activity.

You Will Be

  • Leading, coaching, and holding accountable engineering managers and individual contributors across our application stack, data pipelines, quality engineering, and cloud platform.
  • Build technical leaders that reduces single points of failure and allows the organization to scale without depending on individual heroics.
  • Set and reinforce a high bar for technical judgment, delivery ownership, collaboration, documentation, operational discipline, and customer impact.
  • Own engineering capacity planning, staffing allocations, and the engineering operating budget. Manage cloud, data, AI, tooling, and software vendor spend.
  • Partner with Product, UX, Data Science, and the Chief Product Officer to shape the Polaris roadmap, sequence investments, expose dependencies, and make clear tradeoffs among customer value, speed, reliability, cost, and technical health.
  • Translate agency, client, and market needs into a coherent technology strategy across Polaris IQ, shared data products, and measurement applications.
  • Maintain an actionable architecture roadmap that supports product growth while retiring fragile systems, duplicated capabilities, and unnecessary operational cost.
  • Define and manage an engineering scorecard that tracks delivery speed and quality. Continue moving delivery toward more frequent deployments through automated testing, CI/CD, observability, release automation, and fast feedback loops.
  • Set and execute the engineering AI strategy. Evaluate coding agents, model providers, agent runtimes, and automation opportunities based on measurable value, security, reliability, usability, and total cost.
  • Own the end-to-end technical architecture across Python and Django services, React applications, PostgreSQL, Airflow, BigQuery, dbt, GKE, Cloud Run, Terraform, GitOps, Argo CD, and GitHub Actions.
  • Ensure data pipelines and systems deliver accurate, timely, and observable data across advertising, analytics, commerce, and client data sources.
  • Own service-level objectives, incident management, corrective actions, capacity planning, and risk reduction for application, platform, and data workloads.
  • Act as the final engineering escalation for critical incidents and high-risk architecture decisions, while ensuring durable runbooks, monitoring, and delegated ownership exist afterward.
  • Partner with Security and Legal on secure architecture, identity and access management, secrets, vendor risk, data governance, incident response, client assurance, and compliance obligations.

You Must Have

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering managers and multidisciplinary engineering organizations.
  • A record of building healthy teams, developing leaders, raising accountability, and delivering complex products in close partnership with Product, UX, Data Science, Security, and business stakeholders.
  • Deep architectural judgment across modern SaaS applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, distributed systems, CI/CD, observability, and security. Direct experience with GCP and the Polaris stack is valuable, but equivalent depth in comparable technologies is acceptable.
  • Experience improving developer productivity and delivery performance through platform capabilities, automation, testing, operational standards, and reporting on DevEx KPIs.
  • Practical experience adopting AI-assisted development or agentic workflows, with the judgment to balance speed against security, quality, cost, and maintainability.
  • Demonstrated ownership of cloud and software budgets, vendor relationships, capacity planning, and technical contract decisions.
  • Calm, decisive leadership and the ability to move between executive communication and hands-on technical investigation when necessary.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, especially when explaining risk, architecture, cost, or tradeoffs to clients and non-technical leaders.
  • A bias toward durable systems, explicit ownership, and delegation. This role must solve urgent problems without allowing the organization to remain dependent on a single person.

Nice to Have

  • Digital marketing, advertising technology, agency technology, or high-volume data and analytics integrations.
  • Customer-facing, multi-tenant enterprise products that share data, services, or platform capabilities.
  • Data ingestion and transformation at scale, including heterogeneous APIs, normalized data models, orchestration, warehouse design, and data quality controls.
  • Production support for data science and measurement applications such as marketing mix modeling, forecasting, experimentation, optimization, or anomaly detection.
  • SOC 2 or similar control environments, enterprise identity and access management, and client security reviews.

raw.description:
Role Title: Bilingual Medical Doctor (Korean)

Role Type: Contractor - Part-Time, contract (min. ~15 hrs a week)

Location: Remote, worldwide

micro1 is engaging Medical Doctor - Physician Experts to contribute to a customer’s advanced healthcare project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. You will analyze patient and operational data to enhance healthcare outcomes, using your clinical acumen to inform the development and refinement of intelligent systems that support medical decision-making and workflow improvements.

Scope of Work

  1. Analyze and annotate clinical scenarios, patient cases, and healthcare data to guide AI algorithm development.
  2. Review and provide expert feedback on AI-generated medical content, ensuring clinical accuracy and relevance.
  3. Apply knowledge of diagnostic analysis, medicine, physiology, and healthcare protocols to diverse data sets.
  4. Translate complex clinical terminology and workflows into actionable guidance for AI model training.
  5. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data scientists and engineers, to refine project objectives and deliverables.
  6. Assess AI system outputs, identifying areas for improvement based on real-world clinical experience.
  7. Maintain high standards of data security, privacy, and ethical compliance throughout all project tasks.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Current or recent experience in clinical practice with completion of residency (consideration for those in final year).
  2. Expertise in diagnostic analysis, general medicine, clinical protocols, and physiology.
  3. Preference for contributors from general specialties such as internal medicine, family practice, or emergency medicine; select subspecialties also welcome.
  4. Strong command of clinical terminology and ability to communicate complex concepts in writing and verbally.
  5. Demonstrated analytical skills and attention to detail in clinical and data-driven contexts.
  6. Experience interpreting and working with electronic health records, patient data, or medical documentation.
  7. Commitment to accuracy, compliance, and the advancement of healthcare through innovative technology.
  8. Korean native or high-level fluency (TOPIK Level 5+ or equivalent)
  9. English proficiency: C1 or higher

What to expect:

  1. AI Interview (~35 min),a short conversational screen to assess your experience and fit for the role.
  2. Short questionnaire, if the interview goes well, we'll invite you to complete a brief follow-up to confirm fit and gather logistics.
  3. Client review, strong candidates are shared with the client team for final selection.
  4. Offer & onboarding,if selected, you'll receive an offer and begin onboarding. Expect to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of receiving your credentials.

raw.excerpt: About DuroairDuroair is a dynamic, fast-paced, entrepreneurial company specializing in clean, productive, and safe work environments for industrial processes.
raw.description:
About Duroair

Duroair is a dynamic, fast-paced, entrepreneurial company specializing in clean, productive, and safe work environments for industrial processes. We pair our advanced air filtration systems with custom retractable containment solutions used across Aerospace, Military & Defense, Alternative Energy, Metal Fabrication, and Manufacturing sectors. Our patented systems increase workflow flexibility, reduce costs, improve worker health and safety, and eliminate the need for costly infrastructure changes.

About the Role

We have an immediate opening for a Technical Sales & Business Development Representative with 5+ years of experience in the military, aerospace, MRO, or cleanroom industry. This is a remote, field-based role covering the USA. You will identify and develop new accounts across the Aerospace & Defense supply chain, including MRO facilities, defense OEMs, and prime contractors, while growing relationships with existing customers. The ideal candidate has a hunter mentality, technical credibility, and the ability to engage confidently with engineering, quality, and operations stakeholders.

Core Responsibilities

  • Identify & Qualify Leads: Research and identify potential new clients across the A&D MRO supply chain, including defense OEMs, prime and Tier 1/2 contractors, and precision fabrication shops.
  • Understand Customer Needs: Assess customer needs and challenges around contamination control, surface prep, and protective coatings — and recommend appropriate Duroair solutions.
  • Present Solutions: Deliver engaging presentations that showcase the technical features and benefits of Duroair’s cleanroom, coating, and dust/particulate solutions.
  • Negotiate & Close: Negotiate contracts and close sales deals, managing the full cycle from first contact through proposal, qualification, and approval.
  • Build Relationships: Build and maintain trusted relationships with engineering, quality, and procurement contacts for ongoing support and repeat business.
  • Technical Support: Provide pre-sales and post-sales technical assistance, including guidance on cleanroom classification, MIL-SPEC/AMS compliance, and application troubleshooting.
  • Represent the Company: Attend trade shows, conferences, and supplier days (e.g., AeroDef) to generate leads and strengthen Duroair’s market presence.
  • Reporting & CRM: Maintain accurate pipeline records, quotes, and forecasts in CRM. Prepare regular reports and track sales performance against targets.
  • Team Collaboration: Collaborate with internal marketing, product, and engineering teams to ensure customer needs are met and relay field intelligence back to the business.

Skills Required

  • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of products and processes within the military, aerospace, MRO, coating, or cleanroom industry.
  • Sales Skills: Demonstrated ability to win new accounts and grow territory revenue in a field-based, technical sales environment.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and procurement audiences.
  • Problem-Solving: Ability to identify customer issues, assess application requirements, and recommend the right solution.
  • Relationship-Building: Comfortable building and maintaining strong client relationships over long sales cycles.
  • Time Management: Ability to manage a pipeline, prioritize accounts, and meet deadlines across a broad territory.
  • CRM Proficiency: Comfortable with CRM platforms for pipeline management, call reporting, and forecasting.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with aerospace coating and cleanroom standards (e.g., MIL-SPEC, AMS, NADCAP) is a strong asset.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of technical sales or business development experience in coatings, dust control, cleanroom products, or a related industrial sector with direct A&D exposure.
  • Experience managing the full sales cycle: prospecting, technical presentations, proposals, customer qualification, and closing.
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% within the assigned US territory, including visits to MRO facilities, production floors, and cleanroom environments.
  • Background in chemistry, materials science, aerospace engineering technology, or a related technical discipline is preferred.
  • Existing network within the A&D MRO supply chain is a strong asset.
  • Degree in Chemistry, Engineering Technology, Business, or equivalent experience.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary with a bonus structure tied to new business performance.
  • Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision coverage.
  • The opportunity to represent a specialized, high-value product line where technical expertise is a true competitive differentiator.
